column1: # Documented functions of gmodule/rel_decktutorial.prx (see re/documented.tsv for the columns; registry ids carry the module prefix, addresses here do not).

column3: summary

Draw callback of the deck tutorial (export 3 of libdeck_tutorial_rel). Clears layer 0 to black; unless the scene state 0x22c32 is 0 or 4 it draws the editor screen (0x17574) and then, on layer 4, the tutorial overlays: when bit 0 of 0x22ff4 is set only the quit dialog window 0x22ff8; otherwise the highlight (deck_tutorial_draw_highlight with region 0x22c80, flag 0x2 of 0x22c3e), the allowed-button icons (flag 0x4), the demo button icons while the wait state 0x22c3d is 9, the shoulder hint, and, only while bit 0 of 0x22c3c is set (L not held), the message window (0x1af6c, bit 0 of 0x22c92), the label window 0x22c94 (flag 0x1; Japanese uses a font end-y offset of 0xc0), the panel (deck_tutorial_draw_panel, bit 1 of 0x22c92) and the picture window 0x22ed4 (flag 0x40); ends with system_draw_fade. No return value. Side effects: GE display lists of layers 0 and 4. No direct caller; exported, module callers via import stubs: rel_story(world_state_update_deck_tutorial), rel_deck(ui_draw_deck_editor_frame), rel_title(ui_title_draw_deck_tutorial).

Draws the highlight of opcode 0x05: copies the vertex list of the region from the table 0x211fc (8-byte entries: u16 vertex count, pointer to 12-byte vertices at +4) into inline GE data; for regions 0-3 (the editor tabs) it first patches the first quad with the tab rectangle (rectangle 0x225ac, or 0x225d8 for tab 1 when the low nibble of 0x22560 is 2 or more, widened by the tab offset from 0x4034(tab)). The vertices are drawn into the stencil buffer with a pulsing alpha (frame counter, period 16), then a 480x272 sprite with ambient colour 0xc0000000 darkens everything outside the stencil; render state is restored. Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (deck_tutorial_draw).

column2: void * deck_tutorial_draw_button_icon(void *list, int x, int y, int icon, int lit, int show_arrow)
column3: Draws one button icon from the GIM resource 0x1012 (deck_tutorial_get_resource) at (x, y): icons 0-3 are 30x27 cells at v = icon * 0x1b, u 0, or u 0x1e when lit (face buttons: 0 circle, 1 cross, 2 triangle, 3 square by the callers' bit mapping); 4 and 5 are the L and R icons (37x15, v 0x50 and 0x5f, u 0x3c, or 0x61 when lit); 6 is the select icon (32x14, v 0x6f, u 0x3e, or 99 when lit, drawn 8 pixels lower). When show_arrow is non-zero an animated 26x32 arrow (3 frames at u 0x62 + frame * 0x1a, frame = (frame counter >> 3) % 3) is drawn 0x20 pixels above the icon. Returns the advanced display-list pointer (unchanged when the resource is missing). Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 3 (deck_tutorial_draw_demo_buttons, deck_tutorial_draw_shoulder_hint, deck_tutorial_draw_allowed_buttons).

column2: void * deck_tutorial_draw_dpad_icon(void *list, int x, int y, uint lit_mask, uint pointer_mask)
column3: Draws the directional-pad icon from GIM 0x1012 as four 19x20 segments around (x, y): bit 0 up, bit 1 down, bit 2 left, bit 3 right; a set bit in lit_mask selects the lit cell (u 0x4f instead of 0x3c), a set bit in pointer_mask adds the animated arrow above that segment. Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 2 (deck_tutorial_draw_demo_buttons, deck_tutorial_draw_allowed_buttons), which always pass pointer_mask 0.

Draws the buttons of the wait_button mask 0x22c7c at the bottom right (y 0xe6), right to left from x 0x1ba in steps of 32: circle 0x2000 (icon 0), triangle 0x1000 (2), cross 0x4000 (1), square 0x8000 (3), select 0x1 (6), then the d-pad from bits 0x10/0x40/0x80/0x20; icons are lit while the simulated press step 0x22c78 is 1 or 2. Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (deck_tutorial_draw, while the wait state is 9).

When flag 0x10 of 0x22c3e is set (lit) or the wait state 0x22c3d is 16 (not lit), draws an icon at (0x193, 0xec) with deck_tutorial_draw_button_icon: L (mask 0x22c88 bit 0x100, icon 4), else R (0x200, icon 5), else icon 0 when neither bit is set; otherwise returns at once. Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (deck_tutorial_draw).

Same layout as deck_tutorial_draw_demo_buttons for the allowed-button mask 0x22c84 (allow_buttons opcode) without the select icon; the icons blink with bit 4 of the frame counter. Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (deck_tutorial_draw, when flag 0x4 of 0x22c3e is set).

Draws the backdrop of the panel opcode from GIM 0x1013 (seven 64x256 strips and one 32x256 strip across the top, then eight rotated 64x16 tiles along the bottom) and the panel window 0x22db4 with ui_draw_list_window. Does nothing when the resource is missing. Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (deck_tutorial_draw, bit 1 of 0x22c92).

Builds the editor's card lists for the tutorial: initialises the four 0x20-byte list objects at 0x220c0 + 0x20 * n (deck_alloc_editor_list_buffers, index stored at +0, deck_update_list_total) and the pool list 0x22140 (deck_copy_editor_list with 0x22100, kind 4), then walks the 0x75-entry table 0x212ac (6 bytes: u16 mask of scripts, u16 card id, u8 count in bits 0-6, u8 target list 0-3) and adds every entry whose mask has bit script to its list (deck_add_list_entry, with a value from shop_find_in_sorted_table(card, ui_deck_get_resource(0x8031))), counting them in 0x221ce; finally refreshes all lists (deck_update_list_total, deck_reset_list_view, deck_sort_list_view), copies strTbl string 1 (the deck name) to 0x22180 and calls deck_count_cards_by_frame. script is the tutorial script number (u16 0x22c30, passed through deck_tutorial_init_session). No return value. Side effects: list objects 0x220c0-0x2215f, 0x221ce, 0x22180. Callers: 1 (deck_tutorial_init_session).

One-time set-up after the archive is loaded; script is the u16 0x22c30 (the deck_tutorial%02d.bin number), which deck_tutorial_update loads into a0 in the delay slot of the call: deck_tutorial_init_sample_deck(script), list pointers 0x225a0 and 0x225cc = 0x22120, ui_set_editor_layout(0), font shadow and colour codes on (Japanese: flag 1 on and no trimming of wrap spaces; other languages the reverse), font end-y offset 0, window list 0x224fc on the heap 0x22548, ui_field_init_message_window(heap, 0, 480, 14, 1, 0), message-window graphics from GIMs 0x1010 (deck_tutorial_set_message_cursor_gim) and 0x1011 (deck_tutorial_get_message_window_desc +4), clears bits 0-1 of 0x22c92, calls ui_init_card_detail_panel and points the script program counter 0x22c40 at resource 0x1041. No return value. Side effects: the globals listed, font state. Callers: 1 (deck_tutorial_update).

One frame of the tutorial script interpreter. Sets bit 0 of 0x22c3c unless L (0x100) is held (holding L hides the message, label, panel and picture overlays); when flag 0x4 (allow_buttons) is set copies the pad words masked by 0x22c84 to 0x22c48/0x22c4c/0x22c50/0x22c54 and plays sound 0x7a07 for a newly pressed button outside the mask; a forever repeat (flag 0x8, count < 0) ends when confirm or cancel (0x6000) is pressed. Then by wait state 0x22c3d: 16 shows the shoulder hint after 9 frames (flag 0x10); 10 deck_tutorial_check_wait; 9 deck_tutorial_update_demo_press; 4 runs the panel window 0x22db4 (confirm closes it with sound 0x7a05 once it is fully open, state byte 0x22e9d = 3); 1 waits for the message window (0x1ac38) while overlays are visible; 0 reads the opcode byte at 0x22c40, advances it and calls the handler from the table 0x2156c (a null entry is skipped). While flag 0x10 is set the hint mask 0x22c88 is ORed into 0x22c48. No return value. Side effects: interpreter state 0x22c34-0x22c92, sounds, windows. Callers: 1 (deck_tutorial_update).

Wait state 9 handler. Mode 0x22c74 = 0: runs deck_tutorial_simulate_press and, when it finishes, clears 0x22c76 and returns 1. Mode 1 (multi-step, step 0x22c76): step 0 looks at the card under the active pane's cursor (ui_get_pane_cursor_entry with the pane from bits 4-5 of 0x22560); if it is not a fusion card (card_db_is_fusion) it demonstrates down (0x40, step 1), whose end goes back to step 0, so the cursor walks down until a fusion card is under it; on a fusion card it demonstrates the confirm button (system_get_confirm_button(0)) twice (step 2, then step 3), and the end of step 3 clears the step and returns 1. Returns 0 meanwhile. Other modes return 1. Side effects: 0x22c76, 0x22c78, 0x22c7c and the simulated input words. Callers: 1 (deck_tutorial_run_script).

Wait state 10 handler (opcode 0x0a). Kind 0x22c70: 0 counts frames; 1 counts frames with a newly pressed allowed button (0x22c4c); 2 counts frames with a repeat-pressed allowed button (0x22c54); 3 and 4 only compare the counter 0x22c34 (advanced elsewhere) with the target; 5 returns true when 0x221c0 is 0; 6 returns true when confirm or cancel (0x6000) is newly pressed; other kinds return true. Kinds 0-4 return true when the target 0x22c72 is reached. Side effects: increments 0x22c34. Callers: 1 (deck_tutorial_run_script).

Opcode 0x01 (message): copies 8 argument bytes (u16 string, x, y, width), places the message window (0x1b37c(x, y, width)), sets its text to strTbl string (resource 0x1040, card_db_get_dictionary_word) with 0x1b260, opens it (0x1ac38), sets bit 0 of 0x22c92 and wait state 1, and advances the program counter 0x22c40 by 8. No return value. Side effects: message window, 0x22c92, 0x22c3d, 0x22c40. No direct caller (entry 1 of the opcode table 0x2156c).

Opcode 0x02 (label_text): copies 6 argument bytes (u16 string, x, y), opens the label window with deck_tutorial_open_label(x, y, string), advances 0x22c40 by 6 and sets flag 0x1 of 0x22c3e. No return value. Side effects: window 0x22c94, 0x22c3e, 0x22c40. No direct caller (entry 2 of the opcode table 0x2156c).

Opcode 0x03 (label_off): ui_list_window_reset of the label window 0x22c94 and clears flag 0x1 of 0x22c3e. No return value. Side effects: that window and flag. No direct caller (entry 3 of the opcode table 0x2156c).

Opcode 0x04 (panel): copies 4 argument bytes (u16 string, u16 style), clears and fills the 0x120-byte window object 0x22db4 (position 40,35, size 400x200, margins 12/4, black frame colour, text = strTbl string, heap 0x22548; Japanese sets +0x8c), sets the drawing callback +0x100 from style (1 deck_tutorial_draw_panel_picture_1, 2 _2, 3 _3, else none), opens it (ui_open_list_window), advances 0x22c40 by 4, sets wait state 4 and bit 1 of 0x22c92. No return value. Side effects: window 0x22db4, 0x22c3d, 0x22c40, 0x22c92. No direct caller (entry 4 of the opcode table 0x2156c).

Opcode 0x05 (highlight): reads the u16 region into 0x22c80; regions 0-3 (editor tabs) also switch the editor to that tab through 0x6c50 (region 1 picks between two variants on the low nibble of 0x22560); advances 0x22c40 by 2 and sets flag 0x2 of 0x22c3e. No return value. Side effects: 0x22c80, editor state, 0x22c3e, 0x22c40. No direct caller (entry 5 of the opcode table 0x2156c).
Opcode 0x06 (highlight_off): clears flag 0x2 of 0x22c3e. No return value. Side effects: 0x22c3e. No direct caller (entry 6 of the opcode table 0x2156c).

Opcode 0x07 (allow_buttons): reads the u32 button mask, swaps the circle (0x2000) and cross (0x4000) bits when the system confirm button is cross (system_get_confirm_button(0) == 0x4000) unless flag 0x20 is set, stores it in 0x22c84, sets flag 0x4, clears bits 0-1 of 0x22c92, advances 0x22c40 past the arguments and the next opcode byte and calls that opcode's handler at once. No return value. Side effects: 0x22c84, 0x22c3e, 0x22c40, those of the chained handler. No direct caller (entry 7 of the opcode table 0x2156c).

Opcode 0x08 (allow_off): clears the 40-byte input area 0x22c48, the mask 0x22c84 and flag 0x4 of 0x22c3e. No return value. Side effects: those globals. No direct caller (entry 8 of the opcode table 0x2156c).

Opcode 0x09 (wait_button): copies 8 argument bytes, stores the mode in 0x22c74 and the button mask (circle/cross swapped as in deck_tutorial_op_allow_buttons) in 0x22c7c, resets the step 0x22c76, press step 0x22c78 and counter 0x22c34, advances 0x22c40 by 8 and sets wait state 9. The wait does not read the pad: deck_tutorial_update_demo_press presses the buttons itself. No return value. Side effects: those globals. No direct caller (entry 9 of the opcode table 0x2156c).

Opcode 0x0a (wait): stores u16 kind in 0x22c70 and u16 count in 0x22c72, clears the counter 0x22c34, advances 0x22c40 by 4 and sets wait state 10. No return value. Side effects: those globals. No direct caller (entry 10 of the opcode table 0x2156c).

Opcode 0x0b (show_card): stores the u16 card id in 0x2257c, clears 0x22584, sets bit 0 of 0x2256c and advances 0x22c40 by 2. No return value. Side effects: those globals. No direct caller (entry 11 of the opcode table 0x2156c).
Opcode 0x0c (card_off): clears bit 0 of 0x2256c and calls 0x6b20. No return value. Side effects: 0x2256c and those of 0x6b20. No direct caller (entry 12 of the opcode table 0x2156c).

Opcode 0x0d (repeat): stores the u16 count in 0x22c82 (0 becomes -1, forever), advances 0x22c40 by 2, saves it as the loop start 0x22c44 and sets flag 0x8. No return value. Side effects: those globals. No direct caller (entry 13 of the opcode table 0x2156c).

Opcode 0x0e (repeat_end): when flag 0x8 is set, decrements a positive count 0x22c82; at 0 clears flag 0x8, otherwise jumps back to the loop start 0x22c44 (a count of -1 loops until deck_tutorial_run_script sets it to 1). No return value. Side effects: 0x22c82, 0x22c3e, 0x22c40. No direct caller (entry 14 of the opcode table 0x2156c).

Opcode 0x0f (menu_step): copies 8 argument bytes, stores the u32 item mask in 0x22c8c and the u16 string in 0x22c90 (the first u16 is ignored), advances 0x22c40 by 8 and sets wait state 15, which deck_tutorial_apply_menu_step ends. No return value. Side effects: those globals. No direct caller (entry 15 of the opcode table 0x2156c).

Opcode 0x10 (shoulder_hint): stores the u32 button mask in 0x22c88, clears 0x22c34, advances 0x22c40 by 4 and sets wait state 16. No return value. Side effects: those globals. No direct caller (entry 16 of the opcode table 0x2156c).

Opcode 0x11 (shoulder_off): clears the 40-byte input area 0x22c48, the hint mask 0x22c88 and flag 0x10 of 0x22c3e. No return value. Side effects: those globals. No direct caller (entry 17 of the opcode table 0x2156c).

Opcode 0x12 (toggle_swap): toggles flag 0x20 of 0x22c3e, which disables the circle/cross swap of the button opcodes. No return value. Side effects: 0x22c3e. No direct caller (entry 18 of the opcode table 0x2156c).

Opcode 0x13 (caption): passes strTbl string (u16 argument) to deck_tutorial_set_search_query, which makes it the query of an open text search, and advances 0x22c40 by 2. No return value. Side effects: the search query. No direct caller (entry 19 of the opcode table 0x2156c).

Opcode 0x14 (picture): copies 6 argument bytes (u16 picture, x, y), fills the 0x120-byte window object 0x22ed4 (position x, y, width 0x93, frame GIM 0x1011, heap 0x22548); picture 1 sets height 0x41 and draw callback deck_tutorial_draw_picture_text_1, picture 0 height 0x2f and deck_tutorial_draw_picture_text_0 (other values leave size and callback unset); opens it, advances 0x22c40 by 6 and sets flag 0x40. No return value. Side effects: window 0x22ed4, 0x22c3e, 0x22c40. No direct caller (entry 20 of the opcode table 0x2156c).

Opcode 0x15 (picture_off): ui_list_window_reset of 0x22ed4 and clears flag 0x40 of 0x22c3e. No return value. Side effects: that window and flag. No direct caller (entry 21 of the opcode table 0x2156c).

Opcode 0x16 (cursor): copies 8 argument bytes (u16 mode, u16 unused, u32 value). Mode 0 resets the editor cursor with 0x6c50(0 or 1 by the low nibble of 0x22560, 3, 2); mode 1 calls 0x7004(0, value, packed position, ...) with the fields of the current tab's 0x2c-byte list view at 0x225a4 + 0x2c * tab (tab from bits 4-5 of 0x22560). Advances 0x22c40 by 8. No return value. Side effects: editor cursor state. No direct caller (entry 22 of the opcode table 0x2156c).

Opcode 0x17 (end): clears 0x221c2, sets the scene state 0x22c32 to 3 and starts a 16-frame fade to black (system_start_fade_out(1, 0xff000000, 16)). No return value. Side effects: 0x221c2, 0x22c32, fade state. No direct caller (entry 23 of the opcode table 0x2156c).

Applies a waiting menu_step to a menu window that is being built: every caller runs it just before the window is finished or opened, when the wait state 0x22c3d is 15 (set by deck_tutorial_op_menu_step). If the label is shown (bit 0 of 0x22c3e) and the replacement string 0x22c90 is non-zero, reopens the label at its stored position 0x22cec/0x22cee with deck_tutorial_open_label(x, y, string 0x22c90); writes ~0x22c8c to menu +0xdc (the items the player may not pick) and clears the wait state 0x22c3d. No return value. Side effects: label window, menu +0xdc, 0x22c3d. Callers: 6 (deck_tutorial_open_card_command_menu, deck_tutorial_open_command_submenu, deck_tutorial_open_filter_menu, deck_tutorial_open_sort_menu, ...).

column2: void * deck_tutorial_draw_panel_picture_1(void *list, int x, int y, int width)
column3: Panel drawing callback for style 1: draws GIM 0x1014 as a 256x256 sprite centred horizontally in width at (x, y + 2). Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. No direct caller (set as callback +0x100 of window 0x22db4 by deck_tutorial_op_panel).

column2: void * deck_tutorial_draw_panel_picture_2(void *list, int x, int y, int width)
column3: Panel drawing callback for style 2: draws GIM 0x1015 as a 256x256 sprite centred horizontally in width at (x, y + 2). Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. No direct caller (callback of window 0x22db4 set by deck_tutorial_op_panel).

column2: void * deck_tutorial_draw_panel_picture_3(void *list, int x, int y, int width)
column3: Panel drawing callback for style 3: draws GIM 0x1016 as a 256x256 sprite centred horizontally in width at (x, y + 2). Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. No direct caller (callback of window 0x22db4 set by deck_tutorial_op_panel).

Demonstrates a button press in steps of 0x22c78 timed by 0x22c34: step 0 waits 9 frames then writes the demo mask 0x22c7c into the masked input words 0x22c48 (held), 0x22c4c (pressed) and 0x22c54 (repeat); step 1 clears them; steps 2 and 3 wait 9 frames each; step 4 resets and returns 1. Returns 0 while running (and for an unknown step). Side effects: 0x22c34, 0x22c78, input words. Callers: 1 (deck_tutorial_update_demo_press).

column2: void * deck_tutorial_draw_picture_text_0(void *list, int x, int y)
column3: Draw callback of picture window 0: copies the two 6-byte command item records 0x215cc and 0x215d4 (u16 icon resource, u8 u, u8 v, u16 string number) to the stack and draws them with ui_draw_command_item_button at (x, y + 1) and (x, y + 0x13), width 0x88, colour 0. Returns the advanced display-list pointer, which ui_draw_list_window stores. Side effects: GE and font commands. No direct caller (set as callback +0x100 of window 0x22ed4 by deck_tutorial_op_picture).

column2: void * deck_tutorial_draw_picture_text_1(void *list, int x, int y)
column3: Draw callback of picture window 1: copies the three 6-byte command item records 0x215dc, 0x215e4 and 0x215ec (u16 icon resource, u8 u, u8 v, u16 string number) to the stack and draws them with ui_draw_command_item_button at y + 1, y + 0x13 and y + 0x25, width 0x88, colour 0. Returns the advanced display-list pointer, which ui_draw_list_window stores. Side effects: GE and font commands. No direct caller (set as callback +0x100 of window 0x22ed4 by deck_tutorial_op_picture).

column2: void deck_tutorial_open_label(short x, short y, int string_id)
column3: Opens the label window: resets it if shown, clears and fills the 0x120-byte window object 0x22c94 (anchor 0x1dc - x, 0x10c - y, stored x/y at 0x22cec/0x22cee, margins 6/2, text strTbl string, frame GIM 0x1011, heap 0x22548; Japanese sets +0x8c and a font end-y offset of 0xc0 while opening), opens it with ui_open_list_window and resets the font offset. No return value. Side effects: window 0x22c94, font state. Callers: 2 (deck_tutorial_op_label_text, deck_tutorial_apply_menu_step).

Fills the 0x120-byte window object 0x22ff8 with strTbl string 3 (hypothesis, medium: the end-tutorial question), heap 0x22548 and style bytes, opens it, centres it on the 480x272 screen from its size and sets bit 0 of 0x22ff4, which makes deck_tutorial_draw replace the layer 4 overlays with this window alone (the editor is still drawn below it). No return value. Side effects: window 0x22ff8, 0x22ff4. Callers: 1 (deck_tutorial_update).

Calls 0x110a8, clears the loader byte 0x220b0 and sets its bit 0 (idle), and sorts the 9-entry, 12-byte resource table 0x21690 by id (system_qsort with deck_compare_u16_ascending). No return value. Side effects: 0x220b0, order of 0x21690. Callers: 1 (deck_tutorial_start).

Loading step driven by bits 1-7 of 0x220b0 while bit 0 (idle) is set: count 0 starts the archive load (deck_tutorial_load_archive); count 1 (archive bound) waits for deck_tutorial_poll_editor_load and then advances; a higher count resets the counter (bit 0 kept) and returns 1. Returns 0 while loading and whenever bit 0 is clear. Side effects: 0x220b0, the load. Callers: 1 (deck_tutorial_update).
Frees the archive buffer 0x220b4 from the heap 0x22548 if set and clears it. No return value. Side effects: heap, 0x220b4. Callers: 1 (deck_tutorial_shutdown).

Returns the loaded archive 0x220b4; when none is loaded and the loader is idle (bit 0 of 0x220b0), clears that bit, allocates a buffer of container_get_file_size(3, "deck/tutorial.ehp") from heap 0x22548 and starts container_load_file with callback shop_on_archive_loaded, returning 0. Side effects: 0x220b0, 0x220b4, heap, file load. Callers: 2 (deck_tutorial_poll_load, deck_tutorial_get_resource).

Looks up id in the 9-entry resource table 0x21690 (12 bytes: id, cached pointer +4, name format +8; binary search 0x3518); on first use formats the member name with system_sprintf (id 0x1041 with the script number 0x22c30, others with the language letter "jegfis"[save_get_language()]), finds it in the archive (container_ehp_find_member) and caches the pointer. Returns the member pointer, or 0 when the id is unknown or the archive is not loaded. Side effects: the cache field of the table entry. Callers: 14 (deck_tutorial_draw_button_icon, deck_tutorial_op_message, deck_tutorial_draw_panel, deck_tutorial_init_session, ...).

Archive load callback (same code as rel_shop's): when size > 0 binds the EHP (container_ehp_bind_with_callback(NULL, ehp) if ehp is set) and increments the loaded counter in bits 1-7 of the loader byte 0x220b0; always sets bit 0 (idle). Returns size > 0. Side effects: 0x220b0, the EHP binding. No direct caller (file load callback passed by deck_tutorial_load_archive).
Comparator: returns *a - *b (u16 values, ascending order). No side effects. No direct caller (passed to system_qsort by deck_tutorial_init_resources).

column2: int shop_bsearch_resource_table(ushort id, void *table, int count, int entry_size)
column3: Binary search of id in a table of count entries of entry_size bytes sorted by the u16 at entry +0 (same code as rel_shop's); returns the entry index or -1. No side effects. Callers: 1 (deck_tutorial_get_resource).
Module entry point of rel_decktutorial (ELF e_entry 0x3590), with nothing to do. Returns 0 at once. No side effects. No direct caller (run by the module loader through e_entry).

Start callback of the deck tutorial (export 1 of libdeck_tutorial_rel). Clears the 0x15a4-byte state block at 0x22c30 and stores script (the deck_tutorial%02d.bin number) at 0x22c30; for card ids 0xe88-0x1f39 saves each save card byte-1 flag (save_test_card_byte1_flag) into the byte array at 0x22290 + id and clears it; saves the trunk option (save_get_setting_b0_bits6_7) at 0x241ca and sets it to 0; clears the editor list block 0x220c0 (0x4a0 bytes) and the editor state 0x22560 (0x6c4 bytes). Memory: without heap_args (or with heap_args[0] == 0) it creates a 0x5c0000-byte fixed pool (sceKernelCreateFpl, id 0x241cc, block 0x241d0), otherwise it allocates the block from the caller's heap heap_args[0] (kept at 0x22c38); either way a heap is created on it (0x22548); heap_args[1] goes to 0x22550. Sets the thread attribute 0x4000 (sceKernelChangeCurrentThreadAttr, VFPU use) and calls deck_tutorial_init_resources. No return value. Side effects: module state, save card flags and trunk setting (restored by deck_tutorial_shutdown), memory pool. No direct caller; exported, module callers via import stubs: rel_story(world_state_start_deck_tutorial), rel_deck(deck_run_deck_tutorial), rel_title(ui_title_update_deck_tutorial).

Update callback of the deck tutorial (export 2 of libdeck_tutorial_rel), a state machine on 0x22c32: 0 polls the archive load (deck_tutorial_poll_load) and then calls deck_tutorial_init_session, starts a 16-frame fade-in from black, hides the loading overlay and goes to 1; 1 waits for the fade, then 2; 2 runs one frame of the script (deck_tutorial_run_script), the editor (0x7750, 0xa078 with the masked input 0x22c48) and opens the quit dialog (deck_tutorial_open_quit_dialog) when START (0x8) is newly pressed; while the quit dialog is open (bit 0 of 0x22ff4) only that window runs: result 2 fades out (state 3), any other result closes it; 3 waits for the fade, then 4; 4 runs deck_tutorial_shutdown. Returns 1 when the shutdown has finished, else 0. Side effects: the whole tutorial state. No direct caller; exported, module callers via import stubs: rel_story(world_state_update_deck_tutorial), rel_deck(deck_run_deck_tutorial), rel_title(ui_title_update_deck_tutorial).

Tear-down steps on 0x221c2: 0 asks the card-image reader 0x2254c to stop (card_db_cip_request_stop) or skips to 2; 1 waits until it is idle (card_db_cip_is_idle) and clears it; 2 closes the message window (0x1abfc) and resets the label, panel and picture windows that are open; 3 frees the buffer 0x2255c, the archive (deck_tutorial_free_archive) and 0xf700's resources, releases the 0x5c0000-byte block (FPL free and delete, or system_free_aligned of the heap and system_heap_free to the caller's heap), restores the card byte-1 flags of ids 0xe88-0x1f39 from 0x22290 + id and the trunk option from 0x241ca, and resets the step. Returns 1 after step 3, else 0. Side effects: memory, save card flags and setting byte 0xb0, windows. Callers: 1 (deck_tutorial_update).

Switches the tutorial's deck editor to layout 0-7 (same code as rel_deck's): saves the pane cursors (0x71b8, pane 0 only in single-pane modes), takes pane 0's list-layout flag and geometry from the 8-byte layout record 0x217b0 + 8 x layout (s16 pane-0 flag, s16 pane-0 geometry, s16 pane-1 flag, s16 pane-1 geometry, -1 = unchanged) by copying the 0x1e-byte geometry record 0x21718 + 0x1e x index to pane +0xc (panes at 0x225a0 and 0x225cc, 0x2c bytes), stores layout in the low nibble of 0x22560 and restores each pane's scroll and cursor from its list (+0x18, +0x1c, +0x1a, +0x1d) with 0x7004. Going to a single-pane layout while pane 1 was active makes pane 0 active and shows pane 1's list there (list 5 stays 5, 4 becomes 2, 3 stays 3); going to two panes while pane 0 shows list 3-5 puts list 0 in pane 0 and that list in pane 1 (active), through 0x6c50. Finally replays the list-tab frames (deck_tutorial_play_list_tab_frames) and reloads the cursor card text (0x6b20) when there is an entry (0x6a98). Returns nothing. Side effects: pane records 0x225a0/0x225cc, 0x22560, list cursor fields. Callers: 3 (deck_tutorial_init_session, ui_apply_layout_choice, deck_editor_handle_browse_input).

column2: int ui_select_layout_index(short pane_count, int narrow, short pane0_list_layout, short pane1_list_layout)
column3: Maps a layout description to the layout index 0-7 (same code as rel_deck's): one pane gives 0 with list layout (flag 1) and 1 with grid layout (flag 0); two narrow panes give 2 (grid, grid) or 3 (grid, list); two wide panes give 5 (grid, grid), 7 (grid, list), 6 (list, grid) or 4 (list, list). Returns -1 for any other combination. No side effects. Callers: 2 (ui_open_layout_submenu, deck_editor_handle_browse_input).

Returns the list-box extent of editor list `list` (0-5) for the current layout class (low nibble of 0x22560): 10-byte records at 0x217f0 (layout modes 0-1), 0x2182c (2-3) or 0x21868 (4-7); the result is the 9-bit x of u16 [0] in the low half and the 9-bit width of u16 [1] in the high half (same code as rel_deck's). No side effects. Callers: 6 (deck_tutorial_draw_highlight, ui_calc_list_tab_rect, ui_calc_list_tab_rect_narrow, ui_get_list_slot_position, ...).

column2: uint ui_calc_list_tab_rect(ushort list, ushort shown_list, ushort *out_rect)
column3: Fills out_rect (x, y, width, height as u16) with the tab rectangle of list `list` from the layout-class record (see ui_get_list_box_extent; tab x and width are u16 [2] and [3]): the shown list's tab is y 0x19, height 0xd; other tabs are y 0x1b, height 0xb, and in layout modes 2-3 (lists 3 and 5 that are not shown) are clipped against the boxes of list 4 and of shown_list (same code as rel_deck's). Returns the anchor x tab x + width - (width - 8 x n) / 2 - 1, n = bits 1-5 of record byte 7 (hypothesis: the label's text position, medium). Side effects: writes out_rect. Callers: 1 (deck_tutorial_draw_list_tabs).

column2: void ui_calc_list_tab_rect_narrow(ushort list, ushort shown_list, ushort *out_rect)
column3: Variant of ui_calc_list_tab_rect for 0x22-pixel tabs (same code as rel_deck's): x = tab x - 0x22 (in layout modes 2-3 the tab x of the record for lists 0-2 when they are not shown), width 0x22, y/height 0x19/0xd for the shown list and 0x1b/0xb otherwise, with the same clipping against list 4 and shown_list. Returns nothing. Side effects: writes out_rect. Callers: 1 (deck_tutorial_draw_list_tabs).

Returns the EHF frame of the list tabs: in single-pane layouts (low nibble of 0x22560 below 2) the list number itself (5 becomes 4); otherwise base 9 (layout modes 2-3) or 0x18 (4-7) + list * 5 + shown_list (minus 3 when shown_list is 3 or more). No side effects. Callers: 1 (deck_tutorial_play_list_tab_frames).

Gets the list-tab EHF (resource 0x8022, or 0x8023 when deck_tutorial_is_editing_other_deck returns true; through ui_deck_get_resource) and, when it exists, sets its play range to the single frame deck_tutorial_get_list_tab_frame(pane 0's list *0x225a0, pane 1's list *0x225cc) with ui_ehf_set_play_range. No return value. Side effects: the EHF player's range. Callers: 2 (ui_set_editor_layout, deck_tutorial_cycle_pane_list).

Opens the card command menu: allocates the 0x18-byte menu record 0x241d4 (+4 entry, +0x10 window) from heap 0x22548; with no entry sets record bit 0 (no-card mode: items offset by 3, 5 items instead of 8, smaller spacing). Fills the 0x120-byte window (title string 0x50 of dictionary resource 0x8033, item count +0xcc, width 0xe8, item drawer ui_draw_card_command_items) and builds the disabled-item mask +0xdc: bit 7 - offset when 0x224a0 is 0, bit 6 - offset when the active pane's list view has no cards (+0x16 bits 6-9), and bit 2 when the active list is not main or side (deck_is_main_or_side_list), when an unmarked entry meets deck_count_key_cards > 0x27, or when the card's frame (card_db_get_frame of 0x22570) is 3 or 10. Points the window's input at the masked tutorial input 0x22c48, applies deck_tutorial_apply_menu_step when a menu_step is waiting (wait state 15), opens it, enforces a minimum width of 0xe8, centres it horizontally and sets the editor mode 0x221c0 to 2. No return value. Side effects: heap, 0x241d4, window, 0x221c0. Callers: 1 (deck_editor_handle_browse_input).

Runs the command menu by sub-state (record 0x241d4 +2): 5 ui_handle_trunk_option_confirm, 4 ui_handle_trunk_option_submenu, 3 ui_handle_layout_submenu (with pad), 2 deck_tutorial_handle_deck_options_submenu, 1 ui_handle_list_tools_submenu, 0 ui_handle_card_command_choice, 10 ui_finish_card_command_menu (its result is returned); sub-states 0-4 are skipped while START (pad +4 bit 0x8) is newly pressed. Returns 0 except for sub-state 10. Side effects: those of the handlers. Callers: 1 (deck_tutorial_update_editor).

Draws the command menu window (record 0x241d4 +0x10) and, when open, its submenu window (+0x14) with ui_draw_list_window (same code as rel_deck's). Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_editor_overlays).

Resets and frees the submenu window (+0x14, if any) and the main window (+0x10) of the command menu record, frees the record from heap 0x22548 and clears 0x241d4 (same code as rel_deck's). Returns nothing. Side effects: heap frees, 0x241d4. Callers: 2 (ui_finish_card_command_menu, ui_handle_list_tools_submenu).

Sub-state 0 of the command menu (same code as rel_deck's): updates the main window and acts on the chosen item (offset by 3 in no-card mode). Cancel (-2), 6 (clear filter) and 7 (undo) start closing the window and go to sub-state 10. 0 sets bit 4 of 0x221c6 (open the card detail view); 1 toggles the entry card's save byte-1 flag (save_test_card_byte1_flag / save_set_card_byte1_flag); 2 toggles the key-card flag (0x7494, from entry byte 5 bit 5); these keep the window open. 3, 4 and 5 open the list-tools, deck-options and layout submenus (sub-states 1, 2, 3) with sound 0x7a08. Returns nothing. Side effects: 0x221c6, save card flags (restored when the tutorial ends), key-card flags, menu record and windows. Callers: 1 (deck_tutorial_update_card_command_menu).

Sub-state 10 (same code as rel_deck's): once the main window has finished closing (state byte +0xe9 != 5) frees the menu (ui_close_card_command_menu); a final choice of 7 starts an undo (0xc42c; returns at once when it started), 6 clears the active list's filter (0x7820) and re-sorts it with its own mode and order (0x121d0); then the editor mode 0x221c0 returns to 0. Returns 0. Side effects: menu freed, list view, 0x221c0. Callers: 1 (deck_tutorial_update_card_command_menu).

column2: int deck_tutorial_open_command_submenu(short title, short caption, short item_count, void *label_callback)
column3: Allocates (once) and fills the submenu window record 0x241d4 +0x14: placed 0x28 pixels right of the main window at y 0x7c, caption and title strings from dictionary resource 0x8033 when non-zero, item_count at +0xcc, width 0xe8, label_callback at +0xfc, input pointer 0x22c48 (the masked tutorial input); applies deck_tutorial_apply_menu_step when a menu_step is waiting. Does not open the window. Returns 1, or 0 when the allocation failed. Side effects: heap, window record. Callers: 4 (ui_open_deck_options_submenu, ui_open_layout_submenu, ui_open_list_tools_submenu, ui_open_trunk_option_submenu).

Opens the list-tools submenu (same code as rel_deck's): deck_tutorial_open_command_submenu(title 0x4d, no caption, 4 items, label callback 0x66f0), sets window flag bit 3 of +200 and opens it with ui_open_list_window. Items: 0 sort, 1 filter, 2 text search, 3 trunk display option. Returns nothing. Side effects: submenu window. Callers: 2 (ui_handle_card_command_choice, ui_handle_trunk_option_submenu).

Sub-state 1 of the command menu (same code as rel_deck's): updates the list-tools submenu; when a result arrives during the window's state 3 it starts closing it (and the main window for results 0-2); once closed it frees the submenu and acts: cancel (-2) returns to sub-state 0, 3 opens the trunk option submenu (ui_open_trunk_option_submenu, sub-state 4), 2 the text search (0x12850), 1 the filter menu (0x8598), 0 the sort menu (0x11538); the last three also free the command menu. Choices play 0x7a08. Returns nothing. Side effects: menu record, windows, the opened tool's state. Callers: 1 (deck_tutorial_update_card_command_menu).

Opens the deck-options submenu (same code as rel_deck's): deck_tutorial_open_command_submenu(title 0x4c, no caption, 6 items, label callback 0x671c); disables item 1 (mask bit 1 at window +0xdc) when the main list's total word (0x220cc) exceeds 60 or the extra (0x220ec) or side (0x2210c) totals exceed 15, and disables items 1, 2, 4 and 5 (mask 0x36) when 0x7730 returns 1 (editing another owner's deck in rel_deck); then opens it. Returns nothing. Side effects: submenu window. Callers: 1 (ui_handle_card_command_choice).

Sub-state 2 of the command menu: when the deck-options submenu returns a result it is reset and freed; 0, 1 and 2 set bits 5-6 of 0x221c6 to 1 and 0x221c8 to 2, 1 or 0 respectively and return to sub-state 0 with the main window active; 3 calls 0x1013c and 4 calls 0x10310, both clear 0x224a0 and close the main window (sub-state 10); cancel returns to sub-state 0. No return value. Side effects: 0x221c6, 0x221c8, 0x224a0, menu record and windows. Callers: 1 (deck_tutorial_update_card_command_menu).

Opens the layout chooser (same code as rel_deck's): deck_tutorial_open_command_submenu(title 0x45) resized to 0xb3 x 0x43 with 6-pixel margins and a custom item drawer at +0x100 (deck_tutorial_draw_layout_items); the current layout (ui_select_layout_index of pane count, narrow flag and the panes' list-layout flags 0x225a4/0x225d0) is stored at record +8 and pre-selected; record +0xa/+0xc keep the inactive pane number and its list. Returns nothing. Side effects: submenu window, record +8..+0xd. Callers: 1 (ui_handle_card_command_choice).

Sub-state 3 (same code as rel_deck's): the eight layouts form two rows of four. Up/Down (pad +0xc 0x10/0x40) switch rows (index + 4 mod 8), Left/Right cycle inside the row; each move applies the layout at once (0x691c) with sound 0x7a04. Confirm chooses (0x7a05); cancel marks the window cancelled and closes it (0x7a06). When the window has closed (+0xe9 == 6): if cancelled, the original layout (record +8) is restored and the menu returns to sub-state 0; otherwise, when the original layout was two-pane and the new mode is single-pane, the saved list (+0xc, object 0x220c0 + 0x20 x list) gets its view reset (0x7820), and the main window closes (sub-state 10). Returns nothing. Side effects: editor layout, panes, menu record, sounds. Callers: 1 (deck_tutorial_update_card_command_menu).

Opens the trunk-option submenu (same code as rel_deck's): deck_tutorial_open_command_submenu(title 0xb4, caption 0xb5, 3 items, label callback 0x67a8), width 0x108 (+100 and +0xf0), current choice marked by the bit mask 1 << save_get_setting_b0_bits6_7() at +0xd8; opens it. Returns nothing. Side effects: submenu window. Callers: 1 (ui_handle_list_tools_submenu).

Sub-state 4 (same code as rel_deck's): when the trunk-option submenu returns, resets it; cancel (-2) reopens the list-tools submenu (sub-state 1); a choice is stored at record +0xe, the confirmation is opened (deck_tutorial_open_trunk_option_confirm), sound 0x7a0c, sub-state 5. Returns nothing. Side effects: menu record, windows. Callers: 1 (deck_tutorial_update_card_command_menu).

Allocates (once, 0x120 bytes from heap 0x22548) and fills the submenu window record 0x241d4 +0x14 as a two-button confirmation: width 0xf0, margins 10/8, caption string 0x34 of dictionary resource 0x8033, font 0xc in black, button style 3 (+0xca low nibble: buttons 2 and 3) with cancel item 3 (+0xd4) and +0xc8 bit 5 set (cancel moves the cursor to that item), input pointer 0x22c48, the tutorial menu hook (deck_tutorial_apply_menu_step) when a menu_step is waiting (0x22c3d = 0xf); opens it and centres it on the 480x272 screen. Does nothing more when the allocation failed. No return value. Side effects: heap, window record. Callers: 1 (ui_handle_trunk_option_submenu).

Sub-state 5 (same code as rel_deck's): when the confirmation returns, resets it; result 2 saves the chosen option (save_set_setting_b0_bits6_7(record +0xe); restored when the tutorial ends), rebuilds the trunk view (deck_reset_list_view(0x22120)), zeroes the scroll and cursor of any pane showing list 3 and the trunk's saved cursor (0x22138-0x2213c), frees the window and closes the menu (sub-state 10); 3 or cancel return to sub-state 0 and clear bits 0-1 of the menu window +0xe8. Returns nothing. Side effects: save setting byte 0xb0 bits 6-7, trunk view, pane cursors, menu record. Callers: 1 (deck_tutorial_update_card_command_menu).

column2: void * shop_draw_menu_separator(void *list, void *verts, short x, short y, short width)
column3: Fills four 12-byte vertices in verts (colour, x, y, z) for two horizontal lines from x to x + width: colour 0xff479fc1 at y and 0xffa9d7e9 at y + 1; disables texturing, draws them as two 2-vertex line primitives (system_ge_draw_array(.., 1, 0x80011c, 2, ..)) and re-enables texturing (same code as rel_shop's). Returns the advanced list. Side effects: verts, GE commands written. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_card_command_items).

column2: void * ui_draw_card_command_items(void *list, uint x, int y)
column3: Item drawer of the command menu window (installed at +0x100 by deck_tutorial_open_card_command_menu; same code as rel_deck's): in card mode draws the entry's thumbnail at (x + 2, y + 2) (0x15300 with resources 0x8001/0x8002/0x8032), the byte-1 flag icon (0x15a28, resource 0x800a) when the card's flag is set and, for main/side lists (deck_is_main_or_side_list), the key-card icon (0x15b18) when the entry is a key card; then each item's label (ui_draw_command_item_label), items 0-2 indented by 0x1d, the cursor frame on the selected item, and a separator (shop_draw_menu_separator into 0x30 bytes of inline data) plus 4 pixels after items 2 and 5. Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. No direct caller (window callback +0x100).

column2: void * ui_draw_command_item_label(void *list, uint item, uint first_item, int x, int y, int width)
column3: Draws command item `item` as a button with 0x1a208 using the 6-byte item record 0x218a4 + 6 x item, at (x, y + 1) with the given width; items 2, 6 and 7 are drawn grey (0xff808080) when their bit (item - first_item) is set in the main window's disabled mask (+0xdc of record 0x241d4 +0x10), otherwise with colour 0 (same code as rel_deck's). Returns the callee's display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_card_command_items).

column2: void * deck_tutorial_draw_layout_items(void *list, int x, int y, int width, int height)
column3: Item drawer of the layout chooser window (record 0x241d4 +0x14): draws the cursor frame (ui_draw_list_window_cursor_frame, 0x28 x 0x18, 2 pixels up and left of the cell) on the selected cell (low 5 bits of +0xd2: column = choice & 3, row = choice >> 2) and, when resource 0x800a exists, the eight 32x16 layout icons at (x + 2, y + 2) in two rows of four cells 0x28 pixels apart, rows 0x18 apart (texture u 0x40 + 0x20 x (i / 4), v 0x40 + 0x10 x (i % 4)). Returns the advanced display-list pointer (v0 of the last draw; ui_draw_list_window stores it in *list_ptr). width and height are passed by ui_draw_list_window and not used. Side effects: GE commands. No direct caller (window callback +0x100 set by ui_open_layout_submenu).

column2: void * deck_tutorial_draw_list_tools_label(void *list, uint item, int x, int y)
column3: Label callback of the list-tools submenu, read from the machine code: a 44-byte tail jump to ui_draw_command_item_button(list, 0x218d4 + 6 x item, x, y + 1, 0xe8, 0), which draws the 6-byte item record (the decompiler folds the target's body in and the graph lists no callee). Returns that call's advanced display-list pointer, which ui_draw_list_window stores. Side effects: GE and font commands. No direct caller (label callback passed by ui_open_list_tools_submenu).

column2: void * deck_tutorial_draw_deck_options_label(void *list, uint item, int x, int y)
column3: Label callback of the deck-options submenu: tail-jumps to ui_draw_command_item_button with the 6-byte record 0x218ec + 6 x item at (x, y + 1), width 0xe8; colour 0, except that items 1, 2, 4 and 5 are drawn grey (0xff808080) when their bit is set in the submenu's disabled mask (+0xdc). Returns that call's advanced display-list pointer, which ui_draw_list_window stores. Side effects: GE and font commands. No direct caller (label callback passed by ui_open_deck_options_submenu).

column2: void * deck_tutorial_draw_trunk_option_label(void *list, uint item, int x, int y)
column3: Label callback of the trunk-option submenu: item 0 draws a 22x9 icon from the resource named by the record at 0x21910 (u/v bytes +2/+3) at (x - 2, y + 5) and its dictionary 0x8033 string (+4) in black at scale 12 through ui_command_draw_text_fit_width_px at (x + 0x15, y + 3), width 0xd1, inside an external font list; other items are drawn by ui_draw_command_item_button with the record 0x21910 + 6 x item at (x, y + 1), width 0xe8. Returns the advanced display-list pointer left in v0 by system_font_end_external_list or ui_draw_command_item_button, which ui_draw_list_window stores (the decompiler drops it). Side effects: GE commands, font state. No direct caller (label callback passed by ui_open_trunk_option_submenu).

column2: void ui_command_draw_text_fit_width_px(int x, int y, int width, void *text)
column3: Pixel wrapper (same code as BOOT.BIN ui_draw_level_badge_text_fit; the decompiler shows only the tail jump): system_font_draw_text_fit_width(x << 6, y << 6, width << 6, text, -1). Side effects: text drawn. Callers: 1 (deck_tutorial_draw_trunk_option_label).

Applies a layout from the layout chooser (same code as rel_deck's): ui_set_editor_layout(layout); when the editor was single-pane before and is now two-pane with pane 1 active, puts the list remembered by the chooser (menu record 0x241d4 +0xc) back in pane 0 (deck_tutorial_cycle_pane_list(0, list, 2)). Returns nothing. Side effects: as ui_set_editor_layout. Callers: 1 (ui_handle_layout_submenu).

Opens the card detail view with a 0x24-byte parameter block (same code as rel_deck's): resources 0x8007, 0x8009, 0x8024, 0x8011, 0x8010 at +0..+0x10 and the card-image reader 0x2254c at +0x1c (ui_card_view_open), then loads the text of the card under the cursor (ui_load_cursor_card_text). Returns nothing. Side effects: card view state, text globals. Callers: 1 (deck_tutorial_init_session).

Returns the view index under the cursor of pane `pane` (0x2c-byte pane records at 0x225a0; same code as rel_deck's): first visible index (+6) + column (+8) + row (+0xa) x columns (+0x22) in grid layout, first visible index + row in list layout (bit 0 of +4). No side effects. Callers: 5 (ui_get_pane_cursor_entry, ui_find_sort_group_index, deck_tutorial_start_card_move, ui_draw_sort_group_header, ...).

Returns the 6-byte list entry under pane `pane`'s cursor (list entries +4 indexed through the view array +0x10 at ui_get_pane_cursor_index(pane)), or NULL when the index is not below the list's view count (+0x14) (same code as rel_deck's). No side effects. Callers: 8 (ui_set_editor_layout, ui_load_cursor_card_text, deck_tutorial_update_demo_press, deck_tutorial_update_cursor_card, ...).

Loads the card under the active pane's cursor into the detail globals (same code as rel_deck's): entry pointer 0x22578, card id 0x22570, image index 0x22572, resets the dwell counter 0x22574; copies its description (card_db_get_description) into the buffer 0x225f8 flattening line breaks (0x17528, size 0x314), measures it at font scale 0xc and stores the overflow beyond 0x4f40 in 0x22564 (minimum 0), zeroes the marquee offset 0x22568; in layout modes below 4 also sets the shown card 0x2257c to the id and 0x22584 to 0. With no entry (or id 0) clears them and sets 0x2257c to -1. Returns nothing. Side effects: the globals above. Callers: 4 (deck_tutorial_op_card_off, ui_set_editor_layout, ui_init_card_detail_panel, deck_tutorial_update_cursor_card).

column2: void deck_tutorial_cycle_pane_list(uint pane, ushort list, short direction)
column3: Shows another editor list in a pane: direction 1 takes the next list after `list`, 0 the previous one, any other value `list` itself; single-pane layouts cycle over 6 lists in pane 0 only (another pane returns at once) but skip lists 4 and 5 (and list 2 when deck_tutorial_is_editing_other_deck), two-pane layouts cycle 3 lists per pane, pane 1 showing lists 3-5: pane 1 always skips its third list (list 5) and is forced to its first list (list 3) when editing another deck, pane 0 skips list 2 only when editing another deck. When the result differs from the pane's current list, saves the cursors (ui_store_pane_cursors), points the pane record (0x225a0 + 0x2c x pane) at list object 0x220c0 + 0x20 x n, restores scroll and cursor from the list (+0x18, +0x1c, +0x1a) with ui_place_pane_cursor and replays the tab frames (deck_tutorial_play_list_tab_frames). No return value. Side effects: pane records, list cursor fields, EHF range. Callers: 9 (deck_tutorial_op_highlight, deck_tutorial_op_cursor, ui_set_editor_layout, ui_apply_layout_choice, ...).

Returns the UTF-16 name of editor list 0-5: dictionary resource 0x8033 string from the u16 table 0x21924; for other values the static string at 0x21930 (same code as rel_deck's). No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_set_card_move_label).

column2: void ui_place_pane_cursor(short keep_cursor, uint index, uint geometry, uint count, ushort *top, ushort *column, ushort *row)
column3: Clamps a pane's scroll and cursor to a list of `count` entries (same code as rel_deck's); geometry holds the columns in the low byte and the visible rows in the high byte (nothing happens with 0 columns). For count below 2 *top becomes 0 (and column and row too unless keep_cursor). Otherwise *top is pulled back when the window runs past the end or set to 0 when everything fits, and *row is corrected by the change. The target index is `index`, or with keep_cursor = 1 the current cursor index clamped to count - 1, in which case nothing more changes while column and row are inside the window; the index is then made visible and *column/*row recomputed. Returns nothing. Side effects: *top, *column, *row. Callers: 7 (ui_set_editor_layout, deck_tutorial_cycle_pane_list, deck_tutorial_op_cursor, deck_tutorial_handle_filter_value_window, ...).

Saves pane cursors into the lists they show (same code as rel_deck's): for which != 1 pane 0 (list *0x225a0), for which != 0 pane 1 (list *0x225cc): first visible index to list +0x18, column and row nibbles to +0x1c, the absolute cursor index to +0x1a and the column count (1 in list layout) to the low nibble of +0x1d. Returns nothing. Side effects: list records +0x18..+0x1d. Callers: 2 (ui_set_editor_layout, deck_tutorial_cycle_pane_list).

Pushes a 10-byte move record on the editor's undo stack (8 records at 0x224a2, count 0x224a0; same code as rel_deck's): increments the count while below 8, otherwise shifts records 1-7 down one place and writes into the last; copies record into the slot. No return value. Side effects: undo stack. Callers: 2 (deck_handle_card_move_input, deck_start_card_transfer).

Pops the editor's undo stack (same code as rel_deck's): when the count 0x224a0 is non-zero, decrements it and copies the 10-byte record at 0x224a2 + 10 x count to out; returns whether a record was popped. Side effects: 0x224a0, out. Callers: 1 (deck_start_undo_move).
Empty function (returns at once). No side effects. Callers: 1 (deck_tutorial_update_deck_message).

Returns 1 when the list kind *list is 0 (main), 2 (side) or 4, else 0 (same code as rel_deck's). No side effects. Callers: 5 (deck_tutorial_open_card_command_menu, ui_draw_card_command_items, ui_draw_list_rows_detailed, ui_draw_list_rows_compact, ...).

Sets bit 5 (key card) of entry byte 5 to on & 1 for every entry with card_id in the three editor lists named by the table at 0x21934 (list objects 0x220c0 + 0x20 x n: count +8, entries +4) (same code as rel_deck's). No return value. Side effects: editor list entries. Callers: 1 (ui_handle_card_command_choice).

Returns 1 when any entry of the three editor lists named by the table at 0x21940 has the key-card flag (bit 5 of entry byte 5), else 0 (same code as rel_deck's). No side effects. Callers: 1 (deck_tutorial_open_deck_message).

Counts the distinct card ids that carry the key-card flag (bit 5 of entry byte 5) in the three editor lists named by the table at 0x2194c (at most 40 tracked) (same code as rel_deck's). No side effects. Callers: 1 (deck_tutorial_open_card_command_menu).
Returns bits 0-1 of the editor state byte 0x221cc (same code as rel_deck's). No side effects. Callers: 1 (deck_check_deck_legality).
Returns bits 2-3 of the editor state word 0x221cc (0 the player's deck in rel_deck) (same code as rel_deck's). No side effects. Callers: 1 (deck_tutorial_is_editing_other_deck).

Returns bits 4-11 of the editor state word 0x221cc, the deck slot being edited (same code as rel_deck's). No side effects. Callers: 6 (deck_build_side_deck_list, deck_tutorial_open_deck_message, deck_build_main_deck_list, deck_build_extra_deck_list, ...).

Returns true when deck_get_editor_owner_kind() is non-zero (the deck being edited is not the player's own). No side effects. Callers: 21 (ui_open_deck_options_submenu, deck_tutorial_play_list_tab_frames, deck_tutorial_cycle_pane_list, deck_filter_by_limit, ...).

Per-frame cursor bookkeeping: increments the dwell counter 0x22574; from 16 frames on sets bit 0 of byte 5 of the cursor entry 0x22578 when there is one (hypothesis, medium: marks the card as seen), and wraps the counter to 0x100 above 0x8000. Unless the shown card is locked (bit 0 of 0x2256c, set by deck_tutorial_op_show_card, deck_tutorial_start_card_move and deck_tutorial_open_sort_menu), reloads the card text (ui_load_cursor_card_text) when the card under the active pane's cursor differs from 0x22570. No return value. Side effects: 0x22574, the entry flag, card text globals. Callers: 1 (deck_tutorial_update).

Rebuilds the view array (+0x10) of an editor list with every entry index (same code as rel_deck's); for the trunk (kind 3) the trunk option save_get_setting_b0_bits6_7 filters it (1: only cards whose save_test_card_byte1_flag is 0, 2: only those with 1); stores the view count at +0x14, clears bits 6-9 of +0x16, sorts with 0x121d0(list, 1, 0) and returns the view count. Side effects: list view. Callers: 7 (deck_tutorial_init_sample_deck, ui_finish_card_command_menu, ui_handle_layout_submenu, ui_handle_trunk_option_confirm, ...).

Starts a text search over an editor list (same code as rel_deck's): clears the 0x14-byte search state at 0x241d8, stores the list's view count (+0x14) at 0x241da and text at 0x241e4, allocates a result array (count x 2 bytes) at 0x241e0 and a 0x10000-byte Horspool shift table filled with 0xff at 0x241e8 (heap 0x22548). No return value. Side effects: search state, heap. Callers: 1 (ui_run_text_search).

Advances the running text search by up to 48 view entries of list (same code as rel_deck's): appends the entry indices whose card matches (deck_card_matches_search_text with the text 0x241e4) to the result array 0x241e0 (count 0x241dc); returns progress in permille, 1000 when finished or without a result array. Side effects: search state. Callers: 1 (ui_run_text_search).

Ends a text search (same code as rel_deck's): frees the shift table, copies the result indices into the list's view (+0x10, count +0x14) and frees them, sets the view mode bits 6-9 of +0x16 to 8, and moves the search text to the front of the 8-entry history of 0x40-byte UTF-16 strings at 0x222a0, removing a duplicate. In the tutorial the history is a module buffer, not the save's edit block. No return value. Side effects: list view, history, heap frees. Callers: 1 (ui_run_text_search).

Filters the list's view in place (same code as rel_deck's): keeps the view entries for which the predicate at 0x21958 + 4 x filter returns non-zero (called with the card id and args[0]); a null entry with filter 7 uses deck_tutorial_filter_by_genre(entry, args); stores the new view count at +0x14 and filter in bits 6-9 of +0x16; returns the new count (the old one if the temporary allocation fails). Side effects: list view, temporary heap use. Callers: 1 (deck_tutorial_handle_filter_value_window).
Filter predicate: true when bit 0x14400(card_db_get_frame(card_id)) (the frame category) of mask is set (same code as rel_deck's). No side effects. No direct caller (filter table 0x21958).

Filter predicate: 1 when the card is a monster (card_db_is_monster) and bit card_db_get_race(card_id) of mask is set, else 0 (same code as rel_deck's). No side effects. No direct caller (filter table 0x21958).
Filter predicate: 1 when the card is a monster (card_db_is_monster) and bit card_db_get_attribute(card_id) of mask is set, else 0. No side effects. No direct caller (filter table 0x21958).

Filter predicate (same code as rel_deck's): builds a level mask by OR-ing the u16 masks at 0x2197c, 0x2197e, 0x21980 for mask bits 0, 1, 2 and returns 1 when the card is a monster and bit card_db_get_level(card_id) of that mask is set, else 0. No side effects. No direct caller (filter table 0x21958).

Filter predicate on frame and icon (same code as rel_deck's): frame 8 with icon 4 -> mask 0x100, icon 1 -> 0x80, icon 0 -> 0x200; frame 7 with icon 0 -> 0x40, 2 -> 2, 3 -> 4, 4 -> 8, 5 -> 0x10, 6 -> 0x20; returns 1 when that mask bit is set, else 0. No side effects. No direct caller (filter table 0x21958).
Filter predicate: true when bit deck_get_card_limit(deck_tutorial_is_editing_other_deck(), card_id) of mask is set (same code as rel_deck's). No side effects. No direct caller (filter table 0x21958).

Genre filter (filter 7): when args[1] bit 0x40 is set and the entry's card is marked (card_db_is_card_marked) with a non-zero 0x14364(card, resource 0x8032), returns true; otherwise reads the card's three genre words (card_db_get_genres) and returns true when word 0 meets the low half of args[0], word 1 the high half of args[0], or word 2 the low half of args[1]. No side effects. Callers: 1 (deck_filter_list_view).

Normalises text (0x84ec) and searches it with deck_search_text_horspool in, successively, the card name without ruby, the name's ruby reading, the description without ruby and the description's ruby reading (system_font_strip_ruby / system_font_extract_ruby_reading); true on the first match (same code as rel_deck's). No side effects. Callers: 1 (deck_step_text_search).

Boyer-Moore-Horspool search of a UTF-16 pattern of length units in text, using the 64K-entry byte shift table 0x241e8 (entries 0xff mean the full length); resets the used entries with deck_clear_search_shift_table and returns a pointer to the match in text, or 0 (same code as rel_deck's). Side effects: shift table (restored). Callers: 1 (deck_card_matches_search_text).

Resets the Horspool shift-table entries used by a search pattern: table[pattern[i]] = 0xff for i < length - 1 (same code as rel_deck's). Side effects: writes table. Callers: 1 (deck_search_text_horspool).

Copies the UTF-16 string in to out normalised for searching (same code as rel_deck's): full-width forms 0xff01-0xff5d become ASCII (+0x120 modulo 0x10000), katakana 0x30a1-0x30f4 become hiragana (-0x60), other characters go through system_towupper; NUL-terminates out. Side effects: writes out. Callers: 1 (deck_card_matches_search_text).

Opens the filter menu for the active pane's list: allocates the 0x18-byte filter record 0x241ec (+0 state, +2 sub-state, +3 bit 0 extra genre value, +4 row, +8 value bitmask, +0x10 menu window, +0x14 value window) and its 0x120-byte menu window (title string 0xa7 of dictionary resource 0x8033, 7 items, width 0xa4, row height 0x12, label callback deck_tutorial_draw_filter_menu_label, input 0x22c48, tutorial menu hook when a menu_step is waiting), opens it centred horizontally at y 0x3a; sets record bit 0 of +3 when any valid card id 0xe88-0x1f39 is marked (card_db_is_card_marked); pre-selects the list's current filter (view mode bits 6-9 minus 1, 0 when out of range) and sets the editor mode 0x221c0 to 4. Does nothing when the record cannot be allocated. No return value. Side effects: heap, 0x241ec, window, 0x221c0. Callers: 2 (ui_handle_list_tools_submenu, deck_editor_handle_tool_input).

Per-frame step of the filter menu (editor mode 4) by the filter record state (0x241ec +0; same code as rel_deck's): 0 updates the menu window; cancel (-2) starts closing it and goes to state 2, a chosen item i opens the value window for filter i + 1 (deck_tutorial_open_filter_value_window), plays 0x7a08, clears the cursor, column, bitmask and sub-state and goes to state 1; 1 runs deck_tutorial_handle_filter_value_window; 2 waits for the menu window to close, then frees it (ui_close_filter_menu) and returns to editor mode 0 (0x221c0). Returns nothing. Side effects: filter record, 0x221c0, sound. Callers: 1 (deck_tutorial_update_editor).

Filter value window (filter = menu choice + 1) by sub-state record 0x241ec +2: 0 handles input: confirm on the OK row (row nibble 0xf) chooses item 0 (sub-state 1), but while allow_buttons is active (flag 0x4 of 0x22c3e) only when the value bitmask (record +8) equals the complement of the window's disabled mask +0xdc, i.e. exactly the selection the script asked for; confirm on a value toggles its bit (range start from the 8-byte table 0x219bc + column + row x columns); cancel marks the window cancelled and closes it (sub-state 3, sound 0x7a06); Up/Down move between value rows and the OK row, Left/Right between columns (sound 0x7a04). 1 closes both windows once the value window leaves state 4 (sub-state 2). 2, after the close, applies the filter to the active list (deck_filter_list_view with the bitmask, or only stores the filter number in the view mode when the list is empty), re-places the pane cursor (ui_place_pane_cursor), frees the menu (ui_close_filter_menu), opens deck message 6 with the new count (0x1099c), plays 0x7a0c and returns to editor mode 0. 3 returns to the menu (state 0) once the value window has closed. No return value. Side effects: filter record, list view, pane cursor, windows, 0x221c0, sounds. Callers: 1 (ui_update_filter_menu).

Resets and frees the value window (+0x14, if any) and the menu window (+0x10) of the filter record, then the record itself, all from heap 0x22548, and clears 0x241ec (same code as rel_deck's). Returns nothing. Side effects: heap frees, 0x241ec. Callers: 2 (ui_update_filter_menu, deck_tutorial_handle_filter_value_window).

Draws the filter menu (same code as rel_deck's): in layout modes above 1 first shades the inactive pane with 0x1a2d0(list, other pane, its list kind, 1), then draws the menu window (record 0x241ec +0x10) and, when open, the value window (+0x14) with ui_draw_list_window. Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_editor_overlays).

column2: void * deck_tutorial_draw_filter_menu_label(void *list, uint item, int x, int y)
column3: Label callback of the filter menu window: tail-jumps to ui_draw_command_item_button with the 6-byte record 0x21984 + 6 x (item + 1) (icon resource, u, v, string) at (x, y + 1), width 0xa4, colour 0. Returns that call's advanced display-list pointer, which ui_draw_list_window stores. Side effects: GE and font commands. No direct caller (window callback +0xfc set by deck_tutorial_open_filter_menu).

Allocates (once) and fills the value window (filter record 0x241ec +0x14) for filter 1-7 from its 8-byte range record 0x219bc + 8 x filter (u16 first value, u16 last value, draw callback +4): x = centre of the menu + 0x6d, y = menu y + 4 + filter x 0x12, width 0x8a, height ((last - first + 5) / 5) x 0x19 + 0x35, 25-pixel cells, 5 columns, item drawer ui_draw_filter_value_items; filter 7 uses 0xb7 x 0xe4, 6 columns and y = menu y - 0x16; filter 5 width 0xa3 and 6 columns; filter 3 0xa3 x 0x4e and 6 columns; filter 1 4 columns; other filters with fewer than 5 values one column per value. Sets the input to 0x22c48, applies the tutorial menu hook when a menu_step is waiting and opens it. No return value. Side effects: heap, window. Callers: 1 (ui_update_filter_menu).

column2: void * ui_draw_filter_value_items(void *list, int x, int y, int width, int height)
column3: Item-draw callback of the filter value window (same code as rel_deck's): draws the caption bar from resource 0x8006, the label of the value under the cursor (ui_get_filter_value_label, scale 0xc, white, ui_filter_draw_text_fit_width_px fitted to width - 0x15), then for every value of the filter's range (table 0x219bc) a check mark (ui_draw_filter_check_mark) when its bit is set in the record's bitmask, the cursor frame (0x18 x 0x18) on the selected cell and the value icon through the filter's draw callback (0x219c0, 8-byte stride) at the cell centre, and finally the OK button (ui_draw_list_window_button, highlighted when row 0xf is selected) with string 0x20 of dictionary resource 0x8033 centred in it (ui_list_window_draw_text). Returns the advanced display-list pointer (the list window keeps it). Side effects: GE and font commands. No direct caller (window callback +0x100).

column2: void ui_list_window_draw_text(int x, int y, void *text)
column3: Draws text from pixel x to the right screen edge: system_font_draw_text(x << 6, y << 6, (480 - x) << 6, text) (same code as BOOT.BIN's). Side effects: text drawn. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_filter_value_items).

column2: void ui_filter_draw_text_fit_width_px(int x, int y, int width, void *text)
column3: Pixel wrapper (same code as BOOT.BIN ui_draw_level_badge_text_fit; the decompiler shows only the tail jump): system_font_draw_text_fit_width(x << 6, y << 6, width << 6, text, -1). Side effects: text drawn. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_filter_value_items).

column2: void * deck_tutorial_draw_icon_17px(void *list, short x, short y, short index)
column3: Draws a 17 x 17 icon from resource 0x800a at texture (index x 17, 0), white ambient colour, nearest filtering. Returns the advanced display-list pointer (unchanged when the resource is missing). Side effects: GE commands. No direct caller (reached through a function pointer, probably a draw callback of the filter range table 0x219c0, hypothesis, medium).

column2: void * ui_draw_icon_grid_7col(void *list, short x, short y, uint index)
column3: Draws a 17 x 17 icon from the texture of resource 0x800b: cell index % 7 across (u = (index % 7) x 17) and index / 7 down from v = 0x33, white ambient colour, nearest filtering (same code as rel_deck's). Returns the advanced display-list pointer (unchanged when the resource is missing). Side effects: GE commands. No direct caller (reached through a function pointer, probably a draw callback of the filter range table 0x219c0, hypothesis, medium).

column2: void * ui_draw_icon_16px(void *list, short x, short y, uint index)
column3: Draws a 16 x 16 icon (same code as rel_deck's): indices 0xb and 0xc come from resource 0x800a with (u, v) pairs from the u16 table 0x21a04; other indices from resource 0x800c laid out 8 per row (index < 0xb: cell index; index > 0xc: cell index - 2). White ambient colour, nearest filtering. Returns the advanced display-list pointer (unchanged when the resource is missing). Side effects: GE commands. No direct caller (reached through a function pointer, probably a draw callback of the filter range table 0x219c0, hypothesis, medium).

column2: void * ui_draw_table_icon_a(void *list, int kind, int x, int y)
column3: For kind != 0 draws a 17 x 17 icon described by the 6-byte record 0x21984 + 6 x kind (u16 resource id for 0x11324, u8 u, u8 v) (same code as rel_deck's). Returns the advanced display-list pointer (unchanged for kind 0 or a missing resource). Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_pane_status).

column2: void * ui_draw_filter_check_mark(void *list, short x, short y)
column3: Draws the 26 x 26 check-mark sprite at texture (0x9a, 0xc0) of resource 0x8006 at (x, y) (same code as rel_deck's). Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_filter_value_items).

Returns the UTF-16 label of value `value` of filter `filter` (same code as rel_deck's): 1 dictionary resource 0x8033 string from the u16 table 0x21a0c, 2 card_db_get_race_name, 3 card_db_get_attribute_name, 4 string from the u16 table 0x21a1c, 5 from the u16 table 0x21a24 offset by 4 entries, 6 from 0x21a24, 7 card_db_get_genre_name; NULL for other filters. No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_filter_value_items).

One frame of the tutorial's deck editor, called with the masked tutorial input 0x22c48: runs 0xb06c, then, while bits 7-14 of the editor word 0x22560 are 0, dispatches on the editor mode 0x221c0 (0, 6, 7 deck_editor_handle_browse_input; 1 0xd084, the card move; 2 deck_tutorial_update_card_command_menu; 3 0x11a04, the sort menu; 4 ui_update_filter_menu; 5 0x12a7c, the text search), runs 0xb1c0 and returns 0; otherwise returns the result of 0x10f08. Side effects: those of the handlers. Callers: 1 (deck_tutorial_update).

Browse-mode input of the tutorial editor (same code as rel_deck's; pad: +0 held, +4 pressed, +0xc repeat): repeated d-pad moves the active pane's cursor (ui_move_pane_grid_cursor or ui_move_pane_list_cursor by pane flag bit 0 at 0x225a4 + pane x 0x2c); holding L (0x100) sets mode 6 and runs ui_handle_pane_scroll_input; holding R (0x200) sets mode 7 and runs deck_editor_handle_tool_input; otherwise mode 0 and: the cancel button checks the deck (0xb32c) and opens deck message 3 when legal, 5 with the offending card, or 4 with the error code (0x1099c); the confirm button runs the card move (0xb548) and opens message 2 with its error code when non-zero (sound 0x7a05 otherwise); Triangle 0x1000 opens the card command menu for the cursor card (deck_tutorial_open_card_command_menu, 0x7a08); Square 0x8000 cycles the pane's list (deck_tutorial_cycle_pane_list, 0x7a0d); Select 0x0001 toggles the active pane between grid and list layout (ui_select_layout_index, ui_set_editor_layout, 0x7a05). Messages play 0x7a0c. No return value. Side effects: editor mode 0x221c0, cursors, messages, sounds, card moves. Callers: 1 (deck_tutorial_update_editor).

Hold-L handler of the browse mode (same code as rel_deck's; pad +4 newly pressed, +0xc repeat). Square (0x8000) pages the active pane back (0xab78(1)), Circle (0x2000) forward (0xab78(0)), Triangle (0x1000) jumps to the previous sort group (0xac54(1)), Cross (0x4000) to the next (0xac54(0)), each with sound 0x7a04; a Select press on a list whose filter field (list +0x16 bits 6-9) is set clears the filter (deck_reset_list_view), re-sorts with the list's sort mode and order (0x121d0) and plays 0x7a05. Returns nothing. Side effects: pane scroll/cursor fields, list view, sounds. Callers: 1 (deck_editor_handle_browse_input).

Handles the hold-R buttons pressed in pad +4 (same code as rel_deck's): confirm starts a card transfer (0xc910); cancel toggles the save card byte-1 flag of the card under the cursor (save_set_card_byte1_flag; restored when the tutorial ends); 0x8000 opens the sort menu (0x11538), 0x1000 the filter menu (deck_tutorial_open_filter_menu); 0x0001 undoes the last move when the undo stack 0x224a0 is not empty (0xc42c); sounds 0x7a05/0x7a08. No return value. Side effects: those actions, save card flags, sounds. Callers: 1 (deck_editor_handle_browse_input).

D-pad cursor movement for a pane in grid layout (same code as rel_deck's): Left/Right (pad +0xc bits 0x80/0x20) change the column (+8), Up/Down (0x10/0x40) the row (+0xa); moving past the first or last column hands over to the other pane with ui_switch_active_pane. Rows scroll the pane's first visible index (+6, in multiples of the column count) inside the list's entry count (list +0x14), wrapping from the top to the last row and back on a fresh Up/Down press (pad +4). Plays 0x7a04 when anything changed. Returns nothing. Side effects: pane record 0x225a0 + 0x2c x pane, active-pane bits of 0x22560, sound. Callers: 1 (deck_editor_handle_browse_input).

D-pad cursor movement for a pane in list layout (same code as rel_deck's): Left (pad +0xc bit 0x80) switches to the other pane with ui_switch_active_pane(pane, rows, 1, row) and Right (0x20) with from_left 0; Up/Down move the row (+0xa) and scroll the first visible index (+6) inside the entry count (list +0x14) using the visible-row count +0x18, wrapping top to bottom and back on a fresh press (pad +4). Plays 0x7a04 when the cursor or scroll changed. Returns nothing. Side effects: pane record 0x225a0 + 0x2c x pane, active-pane bits of 0x22560, sound. Callers: 1 (deck_editor_handle_browse_input).

column2: void ui_switch_active_pane(short pane, uint old_rows, short from_left, ushort old_row)
column3: Makes the other pane active (same code as rel_deck's): from pane 1 the target is pane 0; from pane 0 the target is pane 1 when the layout mode (low nibble of 0x22560) is 2 or more, else pane 0 again. The target column (+8) becomes the last column when from_left is 1 and the target is in grid layout, else 0; the row (+0xa) is old_row rescaled from old_rows to the target's visible rows, clamped to rows - 1. Writes the target pane into bits 4-5 of 0x22560. (Ghidra shows a fifth register argument used as the target for other pane values; both callers pass 0 or 1.) Returns nothing. Side effects: 0x22560, target pane +8/+0xa. Callers: 2 (ui_move_pane_grid_cursor, ui_move_pane_list_cursor).

Pages the active pane (bits 4-5 of 0x22560) by one screen (same code as rel_deck's): computes the number of rows (entry count list +0x14, divided by the column count +0x22 in grid layout) and moves the first visible row by the visible-row count (+0x26 in grid, +0x18 in list layout), forward when back is 0 (clamped to rows - visible) and backward otherwise (clamped to 0); stores the first visible index (+6, multiplied by the column count in grid layout), or 0 when the list fits on one screen. Returns nothing. Side effects: pane +6. Callers: 1 (ui_handle_pane_scroll_input).

Moves the active pane's cursor to the next (back = 0) or previous (back = 1) sort group (same code as rel_deck's): back is passed unchanged in a0 to ui_find_sort_group_index (Ghidra shows no parameter); with a non-negative index it sets the first visible index (+6), column (+8) and row (+0xa) so that the entry is visible, clamping the scroll to the last full page in grid layout and to count - visible rows in list layout. Does nothing for an empty list. Returns nothing. Side effects: pane +6/+8/+0xa of the active pane. Callers: 1 (ui_handle_pane_scroll_input).

Finds the view index of the neighbouring group in the active pane's list (pane record 0x225a0, view array list +0x10, 6-byte entries list +4) under the list's sort mode (low nibble of list +0x16) (same code as rel_deck's): the group key is 0x12678(entry, list, mode), divided by 100 for modes 4 and 5. Forward (back = 0) returns the first index after the cursor (ui_get_pane_cursor_index) whose key differs, or -1 at the end; backward returns the first index of the group before the cursor, 0 at the start or -1 at index 0; for modes 4-5 backward steps only one entry. With no entry under the cursor returns count - 1. No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_jump_pane_to_group).

Scrolls the card text of the detail panel (same code as rel_deck's). In layout modes below 4 (low nibble of 0x22560) it delegates to 0x16710(0x2257c). Otherwise, when the text width 0x22564 is positive, it moves the marquee offset 0x22568 with the analog value at pad +0x10 (above 0xc0: forward by (v - 0xc0) x 6; below 0x40: backward, clamped to 0), else auto-advances by 0x40 per frame once the dwell counter 0x22574 exceeds 0x35, and wraps the offset at width + 0x76c0 (units of 1/64 px). Returns nothing. Side effects: 0x22568. Callers: 1 (deck_tutorial_update_editor).

Computes the cursor rectangle of the active pane into the u16 globals 0x224f2 (x), 0x224f4 (y), 0x224f6 (width), 0x224f8 (height) (same code as rel_deck's): in grid layout x = pane x + grid offset + column x column pitch, y likewise with the row pitch, size 0x17 x 0x1f; in list layout x = pane x + cell offset + 1, y = pane y + cell offset + 1 + row x row height, width = row width - 3, height = row height - 1, except pane 1 in layout modes below 4, which uses its own offsets without the +1 and width - 1. Returns nothing. Side effects: 0x224f2-0x224f9. Callers: 1 (deck_tutorial_update_editor).

Checks the edited deck (same code as rel_deck's): 1 when the main total (0x220cc) is below 40, 2 above 60, 3 when the side total (0x2210c) exceeds 15, 4 when the extra total (0x220ec) exceeds 15; 0 in entry mode 2 (deck_get_editor_entry_mode); else 5 (with *out_card) for more forbidden cards than allowed (1 when save_test_progress_flag_e9_bit0, else 0) or a limited card whose copies in lists 0-2 (0xf7d8 on 0x220c0, 0x220e0, 0x22100) exceed its limit (deck_get_card_limit); 0 when legal. Side effects: *out_card. Callers: 1 (deck_editor_handle_browse_input).

Starts moving the cursor card: allocates the 0x250-byte move record 0x241f0 (byte 6: source pane bits 0-1, source list bits 2-4, target pane bits 5-6; u16 +6 bits 7-9 target count; u16 targets at +8, full flags at +0xe; entry copy +0x28; language-dependent value at +0x18), takes the entry under the cursor and builds the possible targets by source list. Main and extra (lists 0, 1) offer the pool (list 5) for card-list items (entry byte 4 bit 7), else the trunk (list 3); while editing another deck an owner-recipe card (entry byte 5 bit 6) is refused (returns 8 | card << 16; from the extra deck this test is made only for non-card-list items) and no side target is added, otherwise the side deck is added (list 2 in layouts 0-1, list 4 in the others; full when list 4's total 0x2214c reaches 20). The side deck (list 2) offers the pool or trunk likewise and, only in layouts 0-1 with a main total 0x220cc of at most 64, the extra deck for frames 3/10 (full at 20 cards) or the main deck. Trunk and pool (lists 3, 5) offer the extra deck for frames 3/10 (full at 20) or else the main deck (full above 64) plus, unless editing another deck, the side deck (full at 20); they then refuse with 4 when three same-name copies are already in lists 0-2 and with 7, 6 or 5 when the card's limit 2, 1 or 0 is reached (limit 0: deck_count_forbidden_cards against save_test_progress_flag_e9_bit0). List 4 (the alias of the side list) offers the extra or main deck with the same full tests and no refusals. With no target it returns 2. Otherwise it pre-selects the last used target (0x241f4/0x241f6) when the pane matches, shows the card (bit 0 of 0x2256c), prepares the label and window position (ui_set_card_move_label, ui_place_card_move_label), allocates and opens the 0x78-byte move window on list 0x224fc, sets editor mode 0x221c0 = 1 and move state 1, and, while the script waits with kind 3 (wait state 10, 0x22c70 = 3), increments the wait counter 0x22c34. Returns 0 when started (or with no card under the cursor), 9 when an allocation fails, else the refusal code. Side effects: heap, move record, window list, 0x221c0, 0x2256c, 0x22c34. Callers: 1 (deck_editor_handle_browse_input).

Undo of the last card move (same code as rel_deck's): pops a 10-byte record (deck_pop_undo_move) and replays it backwards: allocates the move record 0x241f0 with the record's target list as source and its source as the only target, adapted to the pane layout, copies the entry to +0x28, sets editor mode 0x221c0 = 1 and move state 7; finds the entry in the source list (the recorded index if its id and byte 4 bit 7 still match, else the last matching entry) and its view position (+4), takes the start position from 0xe7b0 and removes the card from the source (0xe69c).
