Returns 1 when an undo started, 0 when the stack is empty or the allocation fails. Side effects: undo stack, heap, move record, editor lists. Callers: 2 (ui_finish_card_command_menu, deck_editor_handle_tool_input).

Quick transfer of the cursor card to its default list without the menu (same code as rel_deck's): allocates the 0x250-byte move record 0x241f0 and picks one target: from main/extra/side the pool (list 5) for card-list items, else the trunk (list 3), aborting for an owner-recipe card while editing another deck; from trunk/pool the extra deck (frames 3/10, aborting at 20 cards) or the main deck (aborting above 64), aborting when 3 same-name copies are already in lists 0-2 or the card's limit (below 3) is reached; from list 4 the main deck. Pushes the 10-byte undo record {source | target << 4, entry, target view position} (deck_push_undo_move), sets editor mode 0x221c0 = 1 and move state 7, takes the start position from 0xe7b0 (+0x230, +0x248/+0x24a) and removes the card from its source list (0xe69c). Returns 1 when the transfer started, 0 otherwise (record freed). Side effects: heap, move record, undo stack, editor lists. Callers: 1 (deck_editor_handle_tool_input).

Per-frame card-move state machine on the low nibble of byte 0 of the move record 0x241f0 (same code as rel_deck's): 1 deck_animate_card_move_flight; 2 waits for the move window's opening transition (ui_window_is_transition_done on list 0x224fc) and goes to 3; 3 deck_handle_card_move_input; 4 (cancel) after the window transition re-adds the entry to its source list at its old view position (0xfc8c), cycles the pane back in single-pane layout and goes to 8; 6 after (+0x22e bits 1-3) frames, once 0xe7b0 reports the target slot, closes the window and goes to 5 (7 without a window); 5 waits for the window transition (then 7) and falls through into 7; 7 0xdc54 (finish); 8 stores the target pane and list in 0x241f4/0x241f6, frees the move (0xe214), clears editor mode 0x221c0 and bit 0 of 0x2256c and returns 1. Returns 0 while the move runs and for other states. Side effects: those of the steps, window list. Callers: 1 (deck_tutorial_update_editor).

Input of the open card-move menu (move state 3) from the pad block (+4 pressed, +0xc repeat) (same code as rel_deck's): Left 0x80 / Right 0x20 cycle the selected target (byte 7 bits 2-4 of the move record 0x241f0) modulo the target count and on a change re-place the label (0xe538), show that list in the target pane (deck_tutorial_cycle_pane_list(pane, list, 2)) and play 0x7a04; repeated Up 0x10 / Down 0x40 scroll the target pane's top index (0x225a6 + pane x 0x2c) by one row; the confirm button, when the target is not full (+0xe + 2 x index), pushes the 10-byte undo record (deck_push_undo_move), sets move state 6 and plays 0x7a05 (0x7a07 when full); the cancel button sets move state 4, closes the window (ui_window_close) and plays 0x7a06. No return value. Side effects: move record, undo stack, pane scroll, window, sounds. Callers: 1 (deck_update_card_move).

Move state 1 (the card flies from its list to the move window), stepped by the high nibble of byte 0 of the move record 0x241f0 (same code as rel_deck's): 0 takes the start position from 0xe7b0 (cursor index +4) into +0x230, the end at the window position (+0x1c + 16, +0x20 + 19) into +0x240 and a quadratic Bezier control point (+0x238: mid x and y = 24 when the y values are within 10; x +-120 and mid y when only x is close; else (start x, 0)), and removes the card from its source list (0xe69c); 1 interpolates the drawn position +0x248/+0x24a over 10 frames, setting bit 0 of +0x22e at frame 5; 2 cycles the target pane's list when the selected target differs from +0x14, makes the window position the new start, clears bit 0 of +0x22e and sets move state 2. No return value. Side effects: move record, editor lists. Callers: 1 (deck_update_card_move).

Move state 7 (the card flies from the move window into its target list), stepped by the high nibble of byte 0 of the move record 0x241f0: 0 computes the target slot position (ui_get_list_slot_position with the target's view position from deck_get_list_view_position) into +0x240 and a quadratic Bezier control point +0x238 (mid x with y + 68, or 24.0 below y 136, when the y values are within 10; x +-120 and mid y when only x is close; else the corner at the lower of the two y values); 1 interpolates the drawn position +0x248/+0x24a over 10 frames; 2 cycles the pane back to the selected list in single-pane layouts, drops the card (deck_drop_card_move), recounts the frame categories (deck_count_cards_by_frame), re-places the cursor of pane 0 and, in layouts 2 and above, of pane 1 on their lists with ui_place_pane_cursor, sets move state 8 and, while the script waits with kind 4 (wait state 10, 0x22c70 = 4), increments the wait counter 0x22c34. No return value. Side effects: move record, editor lists, pane cursors, 0x22c34. Callers: 1 (deck_update_card_move).

Removes the card-move window from the window list 0x224fc, frees its buffer (move record +0x24c) and the move record 0x241f0 on heap 0x22548, and clears 0x241f0 (same code as rel_deck's). No return value. Side effects: heap frees, window list, 0x241f0. Callers: 1 (deck_update_card_move).

Draws the card being moved by the move record 0x241f0 (same code as rel_deck's). States 1, 5 and 7 (low nibble of byte 0): when bit 0 of byte +0x22e is set it first draws the target pane through ui_draw_card_move_target(list, 0), then draws the moved entry (+0x28) with the thumbnail drawer 0x15300 at the drawn position (+0x248 - 11, +0x24a - 15) using resources 0x8001, 0x8002 and 0x8032; state 8 draws nothing; every other state returns ui_draw_card_move_target(list, 1). Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_editor_overlays).

Draws the target side of a card move (same code as rel_deck's): shades the target pane with 0x1a2d0 (pane from bits 5-6 of move-record byte +6, list from the candidate selected by bits 2-4 of byte +7), draws the window list 0x224fc, and, when draw_card is non-zero, draws the moved entry (+0x28) with 0x15300 at (+0x1c + 5, +0x20 + 4). The card is drawn opaque in states 3 and 6, at colour 0x80ffffff in states 4/5 while the window's sprite state (ui_get_card_move_sprite_state) is at most 1, and in state 2 only once that state reaches 3 (half alpha at exactly 3); other states return after the window. Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_card_move).

Places the move menu's label window over the selected target list (same code as rel_deck's): from the target pane (move-record byte +6 bits 5-6, pane record 0x225a0 + 0x2c x pane) and ui_get_list_box_extent of the selected candidate list, stores x at +0x1c (right-aligned and clamped to 0 when it would overflow the pane width), y = 0x2a at +0x20 and the width at +0x24; when the window descriptor +0x24c exists it copies x, y, width into it, sets byte +0xa = 4 and refreshes the text with ui_set_card_move_label. Returns nothing. Side effects: move record +0x1c..+0x24 and the window descriptor. Callers: 2 (deck_handle_card_move_input, deck_tutorial_start_card_move).

Removes the moved card from its source editor list: deck_remove_list_entry(list 0x220c0 + 0x20 x ((byte +6 of the move record 0x241f0 & 0x1f) >> 2), u16 at move +2) (same code as rel_deck's). No return value shown by the decompiler (rel_deck returns the callee's result). Side effects: those of deck_remove_list_entry. Callers: 3 (deck_start_card_transfer, deck_animate_card_move_flight, deck_start_undo_move).

Drops the moved card into its target list (same code as rel_deck's): target index = u16 at move record + 8 + 2 x ((byte +7 & 0x1f) >> 2); copies the 6-byte entry at record +0x28, sets its copies to 1 and byte 5 bit 0, and adds it with deck_add_list_entry(0x220c0 + 0x20 x target, entry, -1). No return value. Side effects: those of deck_add_list_entry. Callers: 1 (deck_tutorial_finish_card_move).

Searches the 16 window-list slots at 0x224fc for the one whose +8 equals the move record's window descriptor (0x241f0 +0x24c) and returns that slot's state word +0xa0, or 0 when none matches (same code as rel_deck's). No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_card_move_target).

column2: int ui_get_list_slot_position(float *out_xy, int pane, uint list, int index, int scroll)
column3: Computes the screen centre of entry index of editor list `list` (objects 0x220c0 + 0x20 x list) as shown in pane `pane` (record 0x225a0 + 0x2c x pane) (same code as rel_deck's). When the pane shows another list it returns the list-box label position (x = pane x + extent offset + half width from ui_get_list_box_extent, y = 32.0). When the index is outside the visible window and scroll is non-zero (and the list kind is not 3) it scrolls the pane by one row, stores the step in bits 1-3 of move-record byte +0x22e and returns 0 so the caller retries; otherwise writes x + 11 and y + 15 (pane-1 list layout in layout modes below 4 adds 1 to y) to out_xy[0..1] and returns 1. Side effects: may write the pane's first visible index and move-record +0x22e. Callers: 5 (deck_tutorial_finish_card_move, deck_start_card_transfer, deck_update_card_move, deck_animate_card_move_flight, ...).

For the trunk (list 3, object 0x22120) returns the view position of the entry holding the card id (deck_find_list_card; the id is passed in a1, which the decompiler hides), or the view count when absent; for other lists returns the view count (u16 at 0x220c0 + 0x20 x list + 0x14) (same code as rel_deck's deck_get_list_view_position(list, card_id)). No side effects. Callers: 4 (deck_tutorial_finish_card_move, deck_start_card_transfer, deck_handle_card_move_input, deck_update_card_move).

Builds the UTF-16 label of the card-move menu at move record +0x2e (same code as rel_deck's): when the selected candidate's full flag (u16 at +0xe + 2 x candidate) is clear, swprintf of string 0x16 of dictionary resource 0x8033 with the target list's name (ui_get_list_name); when full, string 0x55 copied as is. Does nothing when no move is active (0x241f0 == 0). Returns nothing. Side effects: move record +0x2e. Callers: 2 (ui_place_card_move_label, deck_tutorial_start_card_move).

Allocates the arrays of an editor list from heap 0x22548 using the capacity u16 at 0x21a60 + 2 x kind: an entry array of capacity x 6 bytes at list +4 and a view array of capacity x 2 bytes at list +0x10 (nothing when the capacity is 0) (same code as rel_deck's). No return value. Side effects: heap allocations, list +4, +0x10. Callers: 1 (deck_tutorial_init_sample_deck).

Trunk builder (same code as rel_deck's): for ids 0xe88-0x1f39 computes the free copies (own deck: deck_count_free_card_copies_2; another owner's: 0x173ac(slot, id, 0x221e0)) and adds an entry with that many copies and its image index (0x142f0, resource 0x8031) for valid cards with free copies > 0; counts the ids with owned copies (save_get_card_count, or 0x17194) > 0 in 0x221ce. Returns the entry count. Side effects: list arrays, 0x221ce. No direct caller (builder table 0x21a48).

Main-deck list builder (same code as rel_deck's): for each card of list 1 of the edited slot (deck_get_slot_count/deck_get_slot_card, slot from deck_get_editor_slot) writes an entry {id, image index (0x142f0, resource 0x8031), 1 copy, flags cleared} and its view index; for the player's own deck each save card-list entry with state 1 sets byte 4 bit 7 on the last matching entry that lacks it; entries whose id is in the slot's key-card list (0x170c4) get the key flag (byte 5 bit 5). Returns the entry count. Side effects: the list's entry and view arrays. Callers: 1 (deck_reload_editor_lists).

Side-deck list builder (same code as rel_deck's): for each card of list 2 of the edited slot writes an entry {id, image index (resource 0x8031), 1 copy, flags cleared} and its view index; for the player's own deck each save card-list entry with state 2 sets byte 4 bit 7 on the last matching entry that lacks it; entries whose id is in the slot's key-card list get the key flag (byte 5 bit 5). Returns the entry count. Side effects: the list's entry and view arrays. No direct caller (builder table 0x21a48, hypothesis medium).

Extra-deck builder (same code as rel_deck's): one entry (copies 1, flags cleared, image index) per card of list 3 of the edited slot; for the player's own deck each save card-list entry with state 3 sets flag 0x80 of byte 4 on the last matching entry that lacks it. Returns the entry count. Side effects: list arrays. No direct caller (builder table 0x21a48).

List builder (same code as rel_deck's): unless another owner's deck is edited (deck_tutorial_is_editing_other_deck), adds one entry per save card-list entry whose state is not 1, 2 or 3 (id, image index from 0x142f0 with resource 0x8031, copies 1 with flag 0x80, byte 5 bits 0, 5, 6 cleared) and its view index; returns the entry count. Side effects: list arrays. No direct caller (builder table 0x21a48).

Makes dst an alias of editor list src (same code as rel_deck's): when realloc_view is set, frees dst's view array (+0x10) and allocates a new 0x28-byte one from heap 0x22548; copies the entry-array pointer (+4, shared), entry count (+8) and view count (+0x14), and memcpy's view-count x 2 bytes of view indices. No return value. Side effects: dst, heap. Callers: 2 (deck_tutorial_init_sample_deck, deck_reload_editor_lists).

For the six editor lists at 0x220c0 (0x20 bytes each) frees the view array (+0x10) and, except for list 4 whose entries are shared with list 2, the entry array (+4) on heap 0x22548, clearing the pointers (same code as rel_deck's). No return value. Side effects: heap frees, list pointers. Callers: 1 (deck_tutorial_shutdown).

Returns the index of the first entry (6 bytes each, array at list +4, count u16 at +8) whose id equals card_id, or -1 (same code as rel_deck's). No side effects. Callers: 3 (deck_add_list_entry, deck_return_deck_cards_to_trunk, deck_get_list_view_position).

column2: short deck_count_list_copies(void *list, short card_id, int same_name)
column3: Sums the copies (entry byte 4 & 0x7f) of the editor list's entries with id card_id and, when same_name is set, also of entries that card_db_is_same_name matches (same code as rel_deck's). No side effects. Callers: 4 (deck_start_card_transfer, deck_check_deck_legality, deck_tutorial_start_card_move, deck_tutorial_draw_card_row_detailed).

Sums the copies (entry byte 4 & 0x7f) of every entry of the editor list with id card_id into *out_count; returns 1 when any of them has flag 0x80 in byte 4, else 0 (same code as rel_deck's). Side effects: *out_count. Callers: 3 (deck_get_card_sort_key, deck_tutorial_draw_card_row_detailed, deck_get_card_group_key).

Counts the entries (not copies) of editor lists 0 (main), 2 (side) and 1 (extra) whose deck_get_card_limit(deck_tutorial_is_editing_other_deck(), id) is 0 (same code as rel_deck's). No side effects. Callers: 1 (deck_tutorial_start_card_move).

Removes one copy of entry index (same code as rel_deck's): returns 0 for an index outside the list; with 2 or more copies decrements them; otherwise deletes the entry (shifts the array, drops it from the view and renumbers higher view indices, mirrored on the other of lists 2/4 at 0x22100/0x22140, which share the entries); refreshes totals (0x1061c) and returns 1. Side effects: list arrays, view, totals. Callers: 1 (deck_remove_card_move_source).

Adds a 6-byte entry to an editor list (same code as rel_deck's): in the trunk an existing id gets the copies added (and byte 5 bit 0 OR-ed); otherwise the entry is appended, its key flag cleared for kinds 1, 3, 5 or copied from an existing entry of the same id; the view gets the index via deck_insert_view_index(list, index, pos) and totals are refreshed (0x1061c); lists 2 and 4 (shared entries) also update the other list's count and view. No return value. Side effects: list arrays, view, totals. Callers: 3 (deck_drop_card_move, deck_update_card_move, deck_tutorial_init_sample_deck).

column2: void deck_insert_view_index(void *list, uint index, int pos)
column3: Rebuilds the view array (+0x10, count +0x14) with entry index placed at view position pos (same code as rel_deck's): copies the old view in order, keeping an existing occurrence of index when pos < 0 or pos <= count and dropping it otherwise, inserts index when the output position reaches pos, and appends it if it was neither kept nor inserted. No return value. Side effects: list view, temporary heap use. Callers: 1 (deck_add_list_entry).

Clears the 7 u16 counters at 0x221d0 and counts the entries (not copies) of editor list 0 (main) and list 1 (extra) per frame category (0x14400(card_db_get_frame(id)), negatives skipped) (same code as rel_deck's). No return value. Side effects: 0x221d0-0x221dd. Callers: 4 (deck_tutorial_init_sample_deck, deck_tutorial_finish_card_move, deck_reload_editor_lists, deck_return_deck_cards_to_trunk).

Rebuilds every editor list with its builder from the table at 0x21a48 (null entries skipped; totals, view, sort, cleared scroll fields), resets the trunk view, re-aliases list 4 (0x22140) to list 2, recounts frames, re-flags the owner's recipe cards (0x10668), clears the pane cursors and, for slot 1, reloads the deck name into 0x22180 (same code as rel_deck's). In the tutorial it is reached only from deck-options item 3, and it rebuilds the lists from the edited save slot (deck_get_editor_slot) instead of the sample deck (hypothesis, medium: the slot word 0x221cc is cleared at start). No return value. Side effects: editor lists and cursors. Callers: 1 (deck_tutorial_handle_deck_options_submenu).

Empties the main, extra and side lists (objects 0-2 at 0x220c0) (same code as rel_deck's): card-list items (entry byte 4 bit 7) are appended to the pool (list 5, 0x22160) with their view index; other entries are merged into the trunk (list 3, 0x22120: copies added and byte 5 bit 0 OR-ed into an existing entry of the id, else appended with 1 copy). Clears the counts, totals, views and scroll/view-mode fields of lists 0-2 and of list 4, recounts frames (deck_count_cards_by_frame), updates the totals of lists 3 and 5, resets the pane 0 cursor fields (0x225a6-0x225ab) and re-places the pane 1 cursor (ui_place_pane_cursor). No return value. Side effects: editor lists 0x220c0-0x2217f, pane cursors. Callers: 1 (deck_tutorial_handle_deck_options_submenu).

Recomputes the total copies of an editor list: list +0xc = sum of (entry byte 4 & 0x7f) over the entries (array +4, count +8) (same code as rel_deck's). No return value. Side effects: list +0xc. Callers: 5 (deck_tutorial_init_sample_deck, deck_reload_editor_lists, deck_add_list_entry, deck_return_deck_cards_to_trunk, ...).

For slots other than 0, 1 and 0x2e, marks the editor entries that come from the owner's recipe (same code as rel_deck's): deck_flag_all_recipe_cards(slot) when slot is 0x1b or world_get_character_category is neither 0 nor 2, else deck_flag_listed_recipe_cards(slot). No return value. Side effects: flag bit 6 of entry byte 5 in lists 0 and 1. Callers: 1 (deck_reload_editor_lists).

Gets a card list of the slot's character (world_get_character_pointer_pair_84(slot, variant at save state +0x48cc + 0x16c x slot, &count)) and loads the slot's recipe (0x1713c); for each listed card counts its copies in the recipe's main (or extra, for fusion/synchro) list and sets bit 6 of entry byte 5 on up to that many unflagged entries of editor list 0 (or 1) (same code as rel_deck's). No return value. Side effects: editor list entries. Callers: 1 (deck_flag_owner_recipe_cards).

Loads the slot's recipe (0x1713c) and, for each card of its extra and main lists, sets bit 6 of entry byte 5 on the first entry of editor list 1 or 0 with that id that does not have it yet (same code as rel_deck's). No return value. Side effects: editor list entries. Callers: 1 (deck_flag_owner_recipe_cards).

Opens the editor's message window: stores the low half of arg at 0x24b18, clears the 0x120-byte window 0x241f8 and its 0x800-byte text buffer 0x24318 and builds the text from dictionary resource 0x8033 by kind: 2 card-move refusal (code 8: string from 0x21a7c formatted with the card name of arg >> 16 and the owner's name, world_get_character_name_string_first(0, deck_get_editor_slot()); other codes the string from the u16 table 0x21a6c); 3 deck check passed (string 0x21 with a key card, deck_has_key_card, else 0x22; 2 choices, cancel item +0xd4 = 4); 4 deck check error from the table 0x21a80; 5 limit error for card arg (strings 0xba, 0xb9, 0xb8 for limits 2, 1, 0, or 0xbb with 1 when save_test_progress_flag_e9_bit0); 6 filter result (0x53 when arg is 0, else 0x52 with arg; cancel item 1); 7 string 0xb1 with arg + 1 and string 0xc3 + arg (3 choices, cancel item 3). Kinds 3, 6 and 7 set bit 5 of +0xc8 (cancel jumps to the cancel item), kinds 2, 4 and 5 bit 2 (cancel disabled); the choice count is the low nibble of +0xca (1 by default). Kinds 0 and 1 leave the text empty. The window is 0xf0 wide, uses heap 0x22548 and the masked tutorial input 0x22c48, is opened and centred on the 480x272 screen, and the kind is stored in bits 7-14 of 0x22560, which makes deck_tutorial_update_editor run deck_tutorial_update_deck_message instead of its mode dispatch. No return value. Side effects: window 0x241f8, 0x24318, 0x24b18, 0x22560. Callers: 3 (deck_editor_handle_browse_input, deck_tutorial_handle_filter_value_window, ui_run_text_search).

Runs the message window 0x241f8 (ui_update_list_window); when it returns a result the window is reset and the message kind in bits 7-14 of 0x22560 is cleared; for kind 7 a result of 2 sets bit 7 of 0x221c6, any other result calls deck_tutorial_stub_noop. Returns 1 when a kind-3 message (deck check passed) is closed with result 1, else 0. Side effects: window, 0x22560, 0x221c6. Callers: 1 (deck_tutorial_update_editor).
Draws the message window 0x241f8 with ui_draw_list_window and returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_editor_overlays).
Comparator: returns *a - *b (u16 values, ascending). No side effects. No direct caller (passed to system_qsort by ui_deck_init_resources).

column2: int ui_deck_find_resource(ushort id, void *table, int count)
column3: Binary search of `count` 12-byte resource records (u16 id at +0, sorted ascending) for id; returns the record index or -1 (same code as rel_deck's). No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_deck_get_resource).

Resets the editor archive-load state 0x24b20 (cleared, then bit 0 = load may start) and sorts the 41 (0x29) 12-byte resource records at 0x21d2c by id (system_qsort with deck_tutorial_compare_resource_id) (same code as rel_deck's). Returns nothing. Side effects: 0x24b20, the resource table order. Callers: 1 (deck_tutorial_init_resources).

Second loading step of the tutorial, on bits 1-7 of 0x24b20 while bit 0 is set: count 0 requests the deck editor archive (ui_deck_get_archive; the count advances when it is already available), allocates (once) a 0xd1000-byte buffer 0x2255c from heap 0x22548 and opens the card-image reader on it (card_db_open_cardh_cip(buffer, 0xd1000, 0), handle 0x2254c); count 1 waits for card_db_cip_is_ready and advances; a higher count resets the counter and returns 1. Returns 0 while loading. Side effects: 0x24b20, 0x2254c, 0x2255c, heap, archive load. Callers: 1 (deck_tutorial_poll_load).

Returns the deck editor archive 0x22550 (same code as rel_deck's). While it is NULL and bit 0 of 0x24b20 allows a start, formats "deck/all_%c.ehp" (0x21f18) with the language letter from "jegfis" (save_get_language), clears bit 0, gets the size with container_get_file_size(3, name), allocates it from heap 0x22548 and starts container_load_file with callback ui_deck_on_archive_loaded; returns NULL until the load has completed. When the caller of deck_tutorial_start passed an archive (heap_args[1] stored at 0x22550) no load happens. Side effects: 0x22550, 0x24b20, heap, asynchronous file load. Callers: 2 (ui_deck_get_resource, deck_tutorial_poll_editor_load).

Returns the deck/all archive member of resource `id` (same code as rel_deck's): finds the 12-byte record {u16 id, void *cache, char *format} in the 41-record table 0x21d2c (ui_deck_find_resource) and returns its cache; on first use (cache NULL, archive loaded) formats the name with the language letter from "jegfis" (ids 0x8036 and 0x8037 instead take the character at index 2 of the 8-byte string at 0x21f28), looks it up with container_ehp_find_member and caches it; for id 0x8024 it also finds the matching .tmf member (substring 0x21f30 replaced by the 5 bytes at 0x21f38) and applies its flags (ui_ehf_apply_tmf_flags). Returns NULL for an unknown id or while the archive is not loaded. Side effects: the record's cache, tmf flags. Callers: 57 (ui_draw_icon_grid_7col, ui_draw_table_icon_a, deck_tutorial_open_command_submenu, deck_tutorial_open_sort_menu, ...).

Load callback of the deck/all archive: when size > 0 binds the EHP (container_ehp_bind_with_callback(NULL, ehp) if ehp is set) and increments the loaded counter in bits 1-7 of 0x24b20; always sets bit 0 (idle). Returns size > 0. Side effects: 0x24b20, the EHP binding. No direct caller (file load callback passed by ui_deck_get_archive).

Opens the sort menu for the active pane's list: allocates the 0x18-byte sort record 0x24b24 (+0 state, +1 focus, +4 saved view copy, +8 saved mode in bits 0-5 and order in bits 6-7, +0xc content bottom of the key window + 1, +0x10 key window, +0x14 direction window); the key window has 10 items (title string 0xa8 of dictionary resource 0x8033, width 0x88, label callback deck_tutorial_draw_sort_key_label, centred horizontally on the 480-pixel screen), the direction window 2 items placed at the right edge of the key window, as wide as the longer of strings 0x61/0x62 + 0x19 (clamped so it ends at x 0x1d0), label callback deck_tutorial_draw_sort_order_label. Only the key window takes the masked tutorial input 0x22c48 (+0x11c) and, when a menu_step is waiting (wait state 0x22c3d = 15), deck_tutorial_apply_menu_step; the direction window leaves +0x11c at 0. Copies the list's view, pre-selects its current mode - 1 and order, aligns the direction window (shop_place_sort_order_window), sets editor mode 0x221c0 = 3 and bit 0 of 0x2256c. No return value. Side effects: heap, 0x24b24, windows, 0x221c0, 0x2256c. Callers: 2 (ui_handle_list_tools_submenu, deck_editor_handle_tool_input).

Per-frame step of the sort menu (editor mode 3; same code as rel_deck's): state 1 waits for the key window to close, then frees the menu (shop_close_results_sort_menu), returns to mode 0 and clears bit 0 of 0x2256c. State 0 keeps the direction window aligned with the selected key (shop_place_sort_order_window), updates the focused window (focus 0 key window: Right moves focus to the direction window and L/R (pad +4 0x300) flips the direction; focus 1: Left moves back), with sound 0x7a04. Whenever the key or direction selection changed it restores the saved view and re-sorts the list live (deck_sort_list_view(list, key + 1, direction)). When the focused window returns a result both windows start closing (state 1): cancel (-2) restores the saved view and the original mode/order bits of list +0x16; a choice re-sorts with the chosen key and direction. Returns nothing. Side effects: list view and sort bits, sort record, windows, 0x221c0, 0x2256c. Callers: 1 (deck_tutorial_update_editor).

Resets the two list windows of the sort record 0x24b24 (+0x14, +0x10), frees both and the record from heap 0x22548 and clears 0x24b24 (same code as rel_shop's). No return value. Side effects: heap frees, 0x24b24. Callers: 1 (ui_update_sort_menu).

Draws the sort menu (same code as rel_deck's): in two-pane layouts first shades the inactive pane (0x1a2d0(list, other pane, its list kind, 1)), then the key window (+0x10) and the direction window (+0x14) with ui_draw_list_window. Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_editor_overlays).

column2: void *deck_tutorial_draw_sort_key_label(void *list, uint item, int x, int y)
column3: Label callback of the sort key window: draws the 6-byte record 0x21f40 + 6 x (item + 1) (icon resource, u, v, string) with ui_draw_command_item_button (tail jump) at (x, y + 1), width 0x88, colour 0. Returns the advanced display-list pointer of that call, which ui_draw_list_window stores. Side effects: GE commands. No direct caller (window callback +0xfc set by deck_tutorial_open_sort_menu).

column2: void * deck_tutorial_draw_sort_order_label(void *list, uint item, int x, int y)
column3: Label callback of the sort direction window: tail-jumps to ui_draw_command_item_button for the 6-byte record 0x21f84 + 6 x item at (x, y + 1), with the direction window's item width (+0xf0 of sort record 0x24b24 +0x14), colour 0. Returns the advanced display-list pointer (hidden by the tail jump; ui_draw_list_window stores it in *list_ptr). Side effects: GE commands. No direct caller (window callback +0xfc set by deck_tutorial_open_sort_menu).

Positions the direction window of the sort record 0x24b24 (same code as rel_shop's): window +0x14 u16 +0x5a = record +0xc + item height / 2 + (key window +0x10 byte +0xd2 & 0x1f) x item height - direction window height (+0x6e) / 2, item height = key window u16 +0xf2, so it lines up with the selected key. No return value. Side effects: direction window +0x5a. Callers: 2 (deck_tutorial_open_sort_menu, ui_update_sort_menu).

column2: void * ui_draw_table_icon_b(void *list, int kind, int x, int y)
column3: For kind != 0 draws a 17 x 17 icon described by the 6-byte record 0x21f40 + 6 x kind (u16 resource id for ui_deck_get_resource, u8 u, u8 v), the sort key table. Returns the advanced display-list pointer (unchanged for kind 0 or a missing resource). Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_pane_status).

column2: void * shop_draw_sort_order_icon(void *list, int key, int x, int y)
column3: Draws the 17 x 17 icon of sort direction key: resource from the u16 at 0x21f84 + key x 6, texture offset bytes +2/+3 of that record, drawn at (x, y) with white ambient and nearest filter (same code as rel_shop's). Returns the advanced list (unchanged when the image is missing). Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_pane_status).

column2: void deck_sort_list_view(void *list, int mode, uint order)
column3: Sorts the list's view (same code as rel_deck's): builds 8-byte records {view index, position, deck_get_card_sort_key(entry, list, mode)}, sorts them with system_qsort using deck_tutorial_compare_sort_ascending (order 0) or deck_tutorial_compare_sort_descending (order 1), writes the indices back and stores mode in bits 0-3 and order in bits 4-5 of +0x16. No return value. Side effects: list view, temporary heap use. Callers: 6 (deck_tutorial_init_sample_deck, deck_reset_list_view, ui_handle_pane_scroll_input, ui_update_sort_menu, ...).

qsort comparator of 8-byte sort records: orders by the key at +4 ascending with key -2 (no key) always last, and equal keys by the original position (u16 +2) ascending. Returns -1, 0 or 1. No side effects. No direct caller (passed to system_qsort by deck_sort_list_view).

qsort comparator of 8-byte sort records: orders by the key at +4 descending with key -2 always last, and equal keys by the original position (u16 +2) descending. Returns -1, 0 or 1. No side effects. No direct caller (passed to system_qsort by deck_sort_list_view).

Sort key of an entry (same code as rel_deck's): mode 10 0xffff - copies, 9 limit, 2 frame, 1 card_db_get_sort_position; frame 8 with mode 8 the byte at 0x21f98[icon], frame 7 with mode 8 the byte at 0x21f90[icon]; non-spell/trap cards: 7 attribute, 6 race, 5 0xffff - DEF and 4 0xffff - ATK (0x10000 for '?'), 3 0xffff - level; -2 otherwise. No side effects. Callers: 1 (deck_sort_list_view).

Group value of an entry for sort mode mode (same code as rel_deck's): 10 copies (trunk entry or deck_get_list_card_count), 9 limit, 2 frame, 1 card_db_get_top_group; frames 7 and 8 give the icon (0 -> 7) for mode 8, else -2; other cards: 7 attribute, 6 race, 5 DEF, 4 ATK (-1 for '?'), 3 level; -2 otherwise. No side effects. Callers: 2 (ui_find_sort_group_index, ui_draw_sort_group_header).

Opens the text search (same code as rel_deck's): allocates the 0x60-byte search record 0x24b28 (+0 state, +2 search step, +4 focus, +6 UTF-16 query, +0x46 progress 0-1000, +0x48 extra height, +0x4c main window, +0x50 history window, +0x54 progress window, +0x58/+0x5c filter windows) and the main window at (0x5e, 0x38), 0x124 x 0x34, title string 0xa5, caption 0x81, drawer 0x13c78. When the active list is filtered (list +0x16 bits 6-9) the extra height is 0x27 and the filter windows are opened (0x135f4). Grows the window to its content, opens the history window (0x132ac) and sets editor mode 0x221c0 = 5. No return value. Side effects: heap, 0x24b28, 0x221c0. Callers: 1 (ui_handle_list_tools_submenu).

Per-frame step of the text search (editor mode 5) on the search record 0x24b28 (+0 state, +4 focus: 0 query box, 2 OK; +0x4c main window, +0x50 history window). State 0: confirm with OK focused chooses item 0 of the main window (sound 0x7a05, state 2); cancel marks the main window cancelled, closes it, the history window and the filter windows (ui_close_search_filter_windows, sound 0x7a06, state 3); otherwise ui_toggle_search_scope, Left focuses the box and Right the OK button (0x7a04), and Down on the box enters the history window (state 1). Unlike rel_deck there is no branch that opens text entry on the box, so the query can only come from the history or from the script (deck_tutorial_set_search_query). State 1: the history window runs; a chosen entry is copied from 0x222a0 + 0x40 x n to the query (+6) and OK gets the focus; cancel, or Up on the first entry, returns to state 0. State 2: once the main window leaves its open state, closes the windows (state 3). State 3: when the main window has closed: if cancelled, frees the menu (ui_close_text_search_menu) and returns to editor mode 0; otherwise resets the windows, releases the filter windows, clears the window pointers and goes to state 4. State 4: ui_run_text_search. No return value. Side effects: search record, windows, query, 0x221c0, sounds. Callers: 1 (deck_tutorial_update_editor).

Runs the search on the active pane's list, stepped by record 0x24b28 +2 (same code as rel_deck's): 0 with an empty query sets the list's filter field (list +0x16 bits 6-9) to 8 and goes to step 10; otherwise, when the list is filtered and the scope 0x221ca is 1, clears the filter first (deck_reset_list_view); with entries it starts the search (deck_begin_text_search(list, query)), resets the progress, opens the progress window (ui_open_search_progress_window) and goes to 1, without entries it begins and finishes at once and goes to 10. 1 waits for the progress window to open; 2 runs deck_step_text_search and stores its progress (per mille) at +0x46, moving on at 1000; 3 finishes (deck_finish_text_search), resets the pane cursor (ui_place_pane_cursor) and closes the progress window; 4 waits for it to close; then (also from 10) frees the menu (ui_close_text_search_menu), opens deck message 6 with the list's new count (deck_tutorial_open_deck_message), plays 0x7a0c and returns to editor mode 0. No return value. Side effects: list view and filter bits, pane cursor, search record, 0x221c0, message window. Callers: 1 (deck_tutorial_update_text_search_menu).

Resets and frees the progress (+0x54) and history (+0x50) windows, releases (ui_release_search_filter_windows) and frees (ui_free_search_filter_windows) the two filter windows, resets and frees the main window (+0x4c) and finally the search record, clearing 0x24b28 (same code as rel_deck's). Returns nothing. Side effects: heap frees, 0x24b28. Callers: 2 (ui_run_text_search, deck_tutorial_update_text_search_menu).

Counts the non-empty entries of the 8 x 0x40-byte search history at 0x222a0; with none returns 0 (same code as rel_deck's). Otherwise allocates (or reuses) the history window (+0x50) and opens it below the main window (x + 6, y = content bottom + 0x11 + extra height), items 0xb0 x 0xe, one per entry, selection initialised past the last entry, label callback deck_tutorial_draw_search_history_item. Returns 1, or 0 on allocation failure. Side effects: heap, history window. Callers: 1 (ui_open_text_search_menu).

Allocates (or reuses) the progress window (+0x54 of record 0x24b28) and opens it at (0x8a, 0x70), 0xcc x 0x30, caption string 0xa6 of dictionary resource 0x8033 in white, no items, drawer ui_draw_search_progress_bar (same code as rel_deck's). Returns nothing (also on allocation failure). Side effects: heap, progress window. Callers: 1 (ui_run_text_search).

Opens the two windows that show the active filter inside the search dialog (same code as rel_deck's): window 0 at (main x + 0x15, main content bottom + 1), 0xfa x 0x27, drawer ui_draw_search_filter_label; window 1 at (main x + 0x2e, bottom + 0x13), 200 x 0x12, drawer deck_tutorial_draw_search_scope_label; each allocated (0x120 bytes) on first use at record +0x58/+0x5c. Returns 1, or 0 on allocation failure. Side effects: heap, filter windows. Callers: 1 (ui_open_text_search_menu).

Calls ui_update_list_window for each existing filter window (record 0x24b28 +0x58, +0x5c; the window pointer is passed in a0, which Ghidra hides) (same code as rel_deck's). Returns nothing. Side effects: window animation state. Callers: 1 (deck_tutorial_update_text_search_menu).

Draws each existing filter window (record 0x24b28 +0x58, +0x5c) with ui_draw_list_window(list_ptr, window), advancing *list_ptr (same code as rel_deck's). Returns nothing. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_text_search_menu).

Starts closing each existing filter window (record 0x24b28 +0x58, +0x5c) with ui_list_window_start_close (window pointer passed in a0, hidden by Ghidra). Returns nothing. Side effects: window state. Callers: 1 (deck_tutorial_update_text_search_menu).

Resets each existing filter window (record 0x24b28 +0x58, +0x5c) with ui_list_window_reset (window pointer passed in a0, hidden by Ghidra). Returns nothing. Side effects: window state. Callers: 2 (ui_close_text_search_menu, deck_tutorial_update_text_search_menu).

Frees each existing filter window from heap 0x22548 (the pointers at +0x58/+0x5c are left as they are) (same code as rel_deck's). Returns nothing. Side effects: heap frees. Callers: 1 (ui_close_text_search_menu).

column2: void ui_draw_search_filter_label(void *list, int x, int y, int width)
column3: Drawer of the first search filter window (same code as rel_deck's): draws string 0x84 of dictionary resource 0x8033 in white at scale 0xc fitted to width at (x, y) (ui_search_filter_draw_text_fit_width_px) inside a font external list on `list`. Returns nothing. Side effects: font commands. No direct caller (window callback +0x100 set by ui_open_search_filter_windows).

column2: void ui_search_filter_draw_text_fit_width_px(int x, int y, int width, void *text)
column3: Pixel wrapper (same code as BOOT.BIN ui_draw_level_badge_text_fit; the decompiler shows only the tail jump): system_font_draw_text_fit_width(x << 6, y << 6, width << 6, text, -1). Side effects: text drawn. Callers: 2 (ui_draw_search_filter_label, deck_tutorial_draw_search_scope_label).

column2: void deck_tutorial_draw_search_scope_label(void *list, int x, int y, int width)
column3: Drawer of the second search filter window: draws string 0x83 (scope 0x221ca = 0, search the filtered view) or 0x82 (scope 1) of dictionary resource 0x8033 in black at scale 0xc, fitted to width at (x, y - 2), inside a font external list. Returns nothing. Side effects: font commands. No direct caller (window callback +0x100 set by ui_open_search_filter_windows).

When the active list is filtered (list +0x16 bits 6-9 non-zero) and Triangle was pressed (pad +4 bit 0x1000), toggles the search scope 0x221ca between 0 (search the filtered view) and 1 (clear the filter and search the whole list) (same code as rel_deck's). Returns nothing. Side effects: 0x221ca. Callers: 1 (deck_tutorial_update_text_search_menu).

Draws the text search (same code as rel_deck's): in two-pane layouts shades the inactive pane first (0x1a2d0), then the main window (+0x4c) and the progress window (+0x54) when present, and the filter windows (ui_draw_search_filter_windows). Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_editor_overlays).

column2: void * ui_draw_search_input_box(void *list, int x, int y)
column3: Drawer of the search main window (same code as rel_deck's): y is lowered by the extra height (+0x48); when the history window exists it is drawn first, and unless OK has the focus the box blinks (bit 3 of the frame counter selects the v = 0x11 row). Draws the query box from resource 0x8006 (left cap 4 px, body 0xb5 px, drop-down cap 0xf px at x + 0xb9), the cursor frame when the box has the focus in state 0, the query in white at scale 0xc (ui_window_draw_text_px(x + 4, y + 7, 0xb5, query)) and the OK button at x + 0xd6 (ui_draw_list_window_button, highlighted when focused) with string 0x20 centred in it (ui_draw_search_box_text). Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE and font commands. No direct caller (window callback +0x100 set by ui_open_text_search_menu).

column3: Draws text from pixel x to the right screen edge: system_font_draw_text(x << 6, y << 6, (480 - x) << 6, text) (same code as BOOT.BIN ui_list_window_draw_text). Side effects: text drawn. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_search_input_box).

column3: Label callback of the search history window: draws history entry 0x222a0 + 0x40 x item in black at scale 0xc, vertically centred in the window's item height (+0xf2) and limited to its item width (+0xf0), with ui_window_draw_text_px inside a font external list. Returns the advanced display-list pointer (system_font_end_external_list is the last call, v0 is kept), which ui_draw_list_window stores. Side effects: font commands. No direct caller (window callback +0xfc set by ui_open_search_history_window).

column2: void * ui_draw_search_progress_bar(void *list, int x, int y)
column3: Drawer of the progress window (same code as rel_deck's): draws the bar frame from resource 0x8006 (v 0xf8, 7 px high: caps at x and x + 0xa0, body 0x9c wide at x + 4, all at y + 8) and the fill: width w = progress (record 0x24b28 +0x46, 0-1000) x 0x9a / 1000, with its end caps, the body drawn only when w > 0. Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. No direct caller (window callback +0x100 set by ui_open_search_progress_window).

When a text search is open (record 0x24b28 non-zero), copies text into its query buffer (+6) with system_wcscpy; otherwise does nothing. No return value. Side effects: the search query. Callers: 1 (deck_tutorial_op_caption).

Binary search of value in the ascending u16 list table[1..table[0]]; returns its index, or 0 when table is NULL or value is absent (same code as rel_shop's). Here it maps a card id to its image slot in resource 0x8031 (deck/all sameCardTbl-style list, hypothesis medium). No side effects. Callers: 6 (deck_tutorial_init_sample_deck, deck_build_trunk_list, deck_build_main_deck_list, deck_build_side_deck_list, ...).

Counts the entries of a sorted u32 table {u32 count, u32 entries[count]} whose low 16 bits equal card_id, stopping at the first larger id (same code as rel_deck's). Returns the count. No side effects. Callers: 1 (deck_tutorial_filter_by_genre).

column2: int shop_find_card_art_variant(uint card_id, int variant, int *table)
column3: Linear search of table (table[0] = count, then count words) for the word (card_id & 0xffff) | variant << 16; returns its index or -1 (same code as rel_shop's). No side effects. Callers: 1 (shop_get_card_thumb_cell).

Maps a card frame to a frame category: 0 -> 0, 1 -> 1, 2 -> 2, 3 -> 3, 7 -> 5, 8 -> 6, 10 -> 4, anything else -> -1 (same code as rel_shop's). No side effects. Callers: 4 (deck_count_cards_by_frame, deck_filter_by_frame, ui_draw_card_frame_plate, ui_draw_sort_group_header).

column2: void * shop_draw_small_digits(void *list, uint xy, int pad, uint value, uint style, uint colour, void *image)
column3: Draws value as small digit sprites from image (ambient colour colour) (same code as rel_shop's): style low byte = number of digit places, high byte = size variant (0: 7 x 9 cells; 3: 7 x 9 cells one pixel tighter; for variants 1 and 2 the cell width is in a register the decompiler does not show); digits are drawn from the rightmost place leftwards with texture u = digit x cell width, and without pad drawing stops after the most significant non-zero digit. Returns the advanced list, or list when image is null. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 3 (ui_draw_pane_status, shop_draw_card_badges, ui_draw_frame_category_counts).

column2: void shop_draw_number_plain(void *list, short x, short y, int value, short step, uint digits, int pad)
column3: Draws value as font text digit by digit from right to left (same code as rel_shop's): starting at x, each digit moves left by step and is drawn with shop_draw_text_line as a one-character string (template 0x21fa0), at most digits places; without pad it stops after the most significant non-zero digit. Wraps the drawing in system_font_begin/end_external_list (the end call's list is what callers use; medium). Side effects: font drawing. Callers: 4 (ui_draw_editor_header, shop_draw_results_row_badges, ui_draw_list_tab_count, ui_draw_sort_group_header).

column3: Draws text from pixel x to the right screen edge: system_font_draw_text(x << 6, y << 6, (480 - x) << 6, text) (same code as BOOT.BIN ui_list_window_draw_text). Side effects: text drawn. Callers: 3 (shop_draw_number_plain, shop_draw_stat_value, shop_draw_button_help).

column2: void * shop_draw_cursor_frame(void *list, int x, int y, int width, int height, void *image, int flags)
column3: Draws a cursor frame around the rectangle (x, y, width, height) from image (same code as rel_shop's): four 6 x 6 corners (texture (0xd5/0xfa, 0x7a/0x9f)), the left/right edges stretched to height - 4 and the top/bottom edges stretched to width - 4; bit 3 of flags enlarges the frame by 2 pixels. Draws nothing when image is null or the size is not positive. Returns the advanced list. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_editor_overlays).

When image is non-NULL: ambient colour white, nearest texture filter, emits image's GIM texture, sprite extent (rect[2], rect[3]) and draws the sprite at (rect[0], rect[1]) with texture offset (rect[4], rect[5]); rect = {x, y, w, h, u, v} (same code as rel_shop's). Returns the advanced list (unchanged for NULL image). Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 9 (shop_draw_race_icon, shop_draw_spell_trap_icon, shop_draw_attribute_icon, shop_draw_results_label_icon_a, ...).

Returns the advanced list. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_race_icon).

column2: void * shop_draw_spell_trap_icon(void *list, uint xy, short icon, void *image)
column3: When icon is non-zero draws its cell with shop_draw_sprite_rect: rect = {x, y from xy, width/height from the word at 0x21fb4, u = (icon - 1) x 0x11, v = 0x33} (same code as rel_shop's). Returns the advanced list (unchanged for 0). Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_spell_trap_icon).

column2: void * shop_draw_attribute_icon(void *list, uint xy, short attribute, void *image)
column3: When attribute is non-zero remaps 7 -> 14, 9 -> 13, 8 -> 7 and draws the cell u = ((attribute - 1) % 7) x 0x11, v = ((attribute - 1) / 7) x 0x11 + 0x44 with shop_draw_sprite_rect (width/height from the word at 0x21fc0) (same code as rel_shop's). Returns the advanced list. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_attribute_icon).

column2: void * shop_draw_results_label_icon_a(void *list, uint xy, ushort kind, void *image)
column3: Draws an icon cell with shop_draw_sprite_rect: x, y from xy, width/height from the word at 0x21fcc, u = kind x 0x11 for kind < 4, (kind - 1) x 0x11 for kind > 4, and for kind 4 u = 0, v = 0x80 (otherwise v from 0x21fd2) (same code as rel_shop's). Returns the advanced list (Ghidra shows void; the call is the last statement). Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_group_header_icon_a).

column2: void * ui_draw_group_header_sprite_b(void *list, uint xy, short index, void *gim)
column3: Draws group-header icon `index` at xy: u = index x 17, v from 0x21fde, size from 0x21fd8, through shop_draw_sprite_rect (same code as rel_deck's). Returns the callee's list pointer (Ghidra shows void; the call is the last statement). Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_group_header_icon_b).

column2: void * shop_draw_results_label_icon_b(void *list, uint xy, short index, void *image)
column3: Draws one cell of an icon strip with shop_draw_sprite_rect: rect = {x, y from xy, width/height from the word at 0x21fe4, u = index x 0x11 + 0x33, v from 0x21fea} (same code as rel_shop's). Returns the advanced list (Ghidra shows void). Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_group_header_icon_c).

column2: void * shop_draw_level_badge(void *list, uint xy, uint level, uint colour, void *image)
column3: When image is non-NULL draws a 9 x 9 star (offset (0x12, 0x53)) at (x, y + 2) and, with ambient colour, the 0x13 x 0xb number cell of level (offset (((level - 1) % 6) x 0x13, ((level - 1) / 6) x 0xb + 0x2d)) at (x + 10, y + 1); x, y = low/high 16 bits of xy (same code as rel_shop's). Returns the advanced list. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 4 (deck_tutorial_draw_card_row_detailed, deck_tutorial_draw_card_row_compact, ui_draw_cursor_card_info, ui_draw_sort_group_header).

column2: void *shop_draw_stat_value(void *list, uint kind_value, uint xy, uint scale, uint colour, void *image)
column3: Draws an ATK/DEF value (same code as rel_shop's): kind_value low half = kind (0 and 1: a text label from the u16 strings at 0x21fec + kind x 10; 2 and 3: an icon sprite rect from 0x22008 / 0x22014 drawn from image, vertically centred), high half = value; font scale x = low byte of scale, y = second byte, colour colour; then up to 4 digits right-aligned after the label (leading zeros suppressed, units always shown), or '?' when the value is 0xffff. Returns the advanced display-list pointer (system_font_end_external_list is the last call; deck_tutorial_draw_card_row_compact keeps it as the list). Side effects: GE commands, font state. Callers: 4 (deck_tutorial_draw_card_row_detailed, deck_tutorial_draw_card_row_compact, ui_draw_cursor_card_info, ui_draw_sort_group_header).

column2: int shop_get_card_thumb_cell(ushort *out_page, short *out_u, short *out_v, ushort *card, int *variant_table)
column3: Finds a card's thumbnail cell (22 x 30 cells, 23 per row) (same code as rel_shop's): for a marked card (card_db_is_card_marked) whose save_get_card_value_bits4_6 > 0 and whose (id, value) is in variant_table (shop_find_card_art_variant, index i) returns page 0, u = (i % 23) x 0x16, v = (i / 23) x 0x1e and 1; otherwise uses the thumbnail index n = card[1]: page n / 391, u = (n % 391 % 23) x 0x16, v = (n % 391 / 23) x 0x1e, and returns 0. Side effects: the three outputs. Callers: 1 (shop_draw_card_thumb).

column2: void * shop_draw_card_thumb(void *list, int x, int y, int shadow, uint colour, ushort *card, void *image, void *variant_image, int *variant_table)
column3: Draws a 22 x 30 card thumbnail (same code as rel_shop's): cell from shop_get_card_thumb_cell using variant_image when an art variant was found, else image; emits that texture page (field_3d_gim_emit_texture); with shadow set first draws a shadow at (x + 1, y + 1) (ambient 0 when colour alpha <= 0xa0, else (colour >> 1) & 0x7f000000); then the thumbnail at (x, y) with ambient colour. The ninth argument is on the stack. Returns the advanced list. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 6 (ui_draw_card_command_items, ui_draw_card_move, ui_draw_card_move_target, deck_tutorial_draw_card_grid, ...).

column2: void * shop_draw_card_badges(void *list, short x, short y, ushort *card, int show_count, int is_new, int show_flag7, int show_bit5, int limit_mode, ushort mark, void *digit_image, void *image, void *overlay_image)
column3: Draws the badges on a card thumbnail at (x, y) for the 6-byte card entry card (same code as rel_shop's): an overlay sprite (0xe9, 0xa5) from overlay_image when bit 6 of +5 is set; with show_count the copies (2..99) as small digits (shop_draw_small_digits) at (x + 8, y + 0x15); when bit 7 of +4 is clear and is_new, a blinking new-card mark (texture (0, 100), 29 x 10, every 8 frames), otherwise the card-limit icon (deck_get_card_limit(limit_mode, id) < 3, texture (limit x 12, 0x4c)); with show_flag7 and bit 7 of +4 a mark (0x25, 0x41), otherwise mark 1-3 as icon ((mark - 1) x 12, 0x58) at (x + 10, y + 0x12); with show_bit5 = 1 and bit 5 of +5 (key card) an icon (0x24, 0x4c) at (x, y + 0x13). Arguments 9-13 are on the stack. Returns the advanced list. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 3 (deck_tutorial_draw_card_grid, deck_tutorial_draw_card_row_detailed, deck_tutorial_draw_card_row_compact).

column2: void * ui_draw_card_frame_plate(void *list, uint xy, ushort width, uint frame, void *gim)
column3: Draws the coloured name plate of a card frame behind a list row (same code as rel_deck's): frames 10, 6, 5, 4 map to plates 3, 0, 2, 1 of texture level 1; other frames use shop_get_frame_style_index (categories 5-6 lowered by 1) on level 0 (field_3d_gim_emit_texture_level). Width below 0x96 draws a 0x49 x 0xd plate; below 0xfa a 0xcb x 0x1f plate at v = c x 32; wider rows draw 0x68 + 0xbf pixels in two pieces. Nothing for a NULL gim or a negative category. Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 2 (deck_tutorial_draw_card_row_detailed, deck_tutorial_draw_card_row_compact).

column2: void * shop_draw_check_icon(void *list, uint xy, short state, void *image)
column3: When image is non-NULL draws a 17 x 17 cell at (x - 1, y - 3) with texture offset (0x22 for state 1, 0x11 for state 0, else 0; v 0x22), white ambient, nearest filter (same code as rel_shop's). Returns the advanced list. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 5 (ui_draw_card_command_items, ui_draw_pane_status, deck_tutorial_draw_card_row_detailed, deck_tutorial_draw_card_row_compact, ...).

Draws the 12 x 12 key-card icon (texture 0x24, 0x4c) at (x - 1, y - 3) (same code as rel_deck's). Returns the advanced display-list pointer (unchanged for a NULL gim). Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_card_command_items).

column2: void * shop_draw_results_row_badges(void *list, uint xy, void *badges, void *label_image, void *icon_image)
column3: Draws three count badges at xy from badges, three 0xc-byte records (byte +0 icon kind, u32 +4 text colour, byte +8 value) (same code as rel_shop's): for each record with a non-zero kind draws the icon from icon_image with the per-kind texture rectangle at 0x2201c (4 bytes per kind: u, v, w, h) at x + i x 0x19 (6 pixels further left for kind 5), a label strip from label_image (v 0xea, height 14, widths from the u16 table 0x22040) and the value with shop_draw_number_plain at x + 0x22038[i] (font 10 x 12, the record's colour; 2 digits for kind 5 and for the third badge, otherwise 1). Draws nothing when either image is null. Returns the advanced list. Side effects: GE commands, font state. Callers: 1 (deck_tutorial_draw_card_row_detailed).

column2: void shop_draw_menu_item_box(void *list, void *item, short x, short y, int width)
column3: Draws a menu item from a 16-byte descriptor item = {+0 image, +4 u byte, +5 v byte, +6 icon w byte, +7 icon h byte, +8 text, +0xc colour flag} (same code as rel_shop's): the icon with shop_draw_sprite_rect at (x, y), then in an external font list (scale 12 x 12, colour 0xff000000 when +0xc is 0, otherwise system_font_set_color with an argument not shown) the text fitted to width - (w + 6) at (x + w + 4, y + (h - 13) / 2) (shop_menu_draw_text_fit_width_px). Side effects: GE commands, font state. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_command_item_button).

column2: void shop_menu_draw_text_fit_width_px(int x, int y, int width, void *text)
column3: Pixel wrapper (same code as BOOT.BIN ui_draw_level_badge_text_fit; the decompiler shows only the tail jump): system_font_draw_text_fit_width(x << 6, y << 6, width << 6, text, -1). Side effects: text drawn. Callers: 1 (shop_draw_menu_item_box).

column2: void shop_draw_scroll_arrow(void *list, int x, int y, uchar direction, uint period, int blink, int show, uint frame, void *image)
column3: Draws a scrollbar arrow from image at (x, y), 8 x 8, texture u 0x77 and v offset 8 when bit 0 of direction is set, flipped when direction > 1: with show a static arrow (v 0x6c), and with blink an overlay arrow (v 0x3c) whose alpha follows a triangle wave of frame modulo period (0 to 255 and back) (same code as rel_shop's). The ninth argument (image) is on the stack. The caller uses the advanced list as a return value, which the decompiler does not show (medium). Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (shop_draw_scrollbar).

column2: void * shop_draw_scrollbar(void *list, int x, int y, int height, int top, int visible, int count, uint style, void *image)
column3: Draws a vertical scrollbar from image (ninth argument, on the stack) (same code as rel_shop's): an 8-pixel track, a 4-pixel thumb whose length is height - 2 - count x 4 / 5 clamped to 10..height - 4 (the whole track when count <= visible) and whose position is top x free length / (count - visible), with texture column 0x77 + 4 x (style & 1) and row (style >> 1) x 0x14; and two arrows (shop_draw_scroll_arrow with period ui_ehf_get_frame_rate() and the frame counter) above and below that blink when the list can scroll up or down, only when bit 0 of style is clear. Returns the advanced list, or list when image is null. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_pane_status).
Returns the frame rate, word +4 of the frame timing record (system_get_frame_timing(); 30 on this disc) (same code as BOOT.BIN's). No side effects. Callers: 1 (shop_draw_scrollbar).

Moves the scroll position word +8 by delta, clamped to 0..max (+0xc); it becomes 0 when max is 0 or a negative delta exceeds the position (same code as rel_shop's). Side effects: scroll +8. Callers: 1 (shop_scroll_with_analog).

When scroll is non-NULL reads the pad state word +0x14 (analog axis, 0..255): above 0xc0 scrolls by (v - 0xc0) x 6, below 0x40 by (v - 0x40) x 6 (shop_scroll_by_delta) (same code as rel_shop's). Side effects: scroll +8. Callers: 1 (ui_scroll_card_text, with the card text scroller 0x2257c).

column2: void * ui_draw_nine_slice_frame(void *list, int x, int y, int width, int height, void *gim)
column3: Draws a nine-slice frame of width x height at (x, y) from gim (corners 4/5 px from texture rows 0x36, 0x3a, 0x3b, edges and centre stretched); does nothing when gim is NULL (same code as the draw module's). Returns the list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 2 (shop_draw_button_help, ui_draw_sort_group_header).

column2: void * shop_draw_button_help(void *list, int x, int y, int variant, uint buttons, void *image, void *dict)
column3: Draws a button help panel at (x, y) (same code as rel_shop's): a 0xd4-wide panel (ui_draw_nine_slice_frame, height 0x58, less one text line unless bit 0 of buttons) with a 0x2f x 0x26 button diagram from image; the dictionary word numbers come from the u16 table 0x22048 (variant 0) or 0x22054 (variant 1) and the words from dict: bit 0 a caption with an icon, 0x1000 (triangle) a title at the top, 0x4000 (cross) a line at the bottom, 0x8000 (square) and 0x2000 (circle) texts in the left and right boxes (0x4d wide; ui_window_draw_text_box_px when the scale from shop_button_help_fit_text_scale_px is below 12, else a scaled single line); in variant 1 the cross and circle words are swapped when the confirm button is not cross; then a header tab above the panel with icon (0x5e, 0x16) or (0x5e, 0x21) by variant and the short text at 0x22060. Returns the advanced list. Side effects: GE commands, font state. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_editor_overlays).

column2: void ui_window_draw_text_box_px(int x, int y, int width, int height, void *text)
column3: Pixel wrapper (same code as BOOT.BIN's; the decompiler shows only the tail jump): system_font_draw_text_box(x << 6, y << 6, width << 6, height << 6, text, -1, 0). Side effects: text drawn. Callers: 1 (shop_draw_button_help).

Tail-jump wrapper (Ghidra shows an empty body; instructions: j system_font_fit_scale_to_width; sll a0, a0, 6): returns system_font_fit_scale_to_width(max_width << 6, text), the horizontal font scale at which text fits max_width pixels (same code as BOOT.BIN system_font_fit_scale_to_width_px). No side effects. Callers: 1 (shop_draw_button_help).

Returns 1 when card_id appears in the key-card list of deck slot slot (deck_get_slot_key_card_count, deck_get_slot_key_card), else 0 (same code as rel_deck's). No side effects. Callers: 2 (deck_build_main_deck_list, deck_build_side_deck_list).

Reads the recipe of deck slot slot (save state +0x48d0 + 0x16c x slot) and, when it is >= 0, loads it into deck with deck_load_recipe; returns recipe >= 0 (same code as rel_deck's). Side effects: writes deck. Callers: 2 (deck_flag_all_recipe_cards, deck_flag_listed_recipe_cards).

column2: int deck_get_other_deck_card_allowance(int slot, uint card_id, uint *recipe_deck)
column3: Copies of card_id another owner's deck may use (same code as rel_deck's): 0 for id 0 or tokens; 3 when the player has obtained it (save_get_card_state != 0), when recipe_deck (0xc0-byte deck: counts at +0/+4/+8, main ids +0xc, side +0x84, extra +0xa2) holds it, or when slot's lists hold it (main/side, or extra for fusion/synchro); else 0. No side effects. Callers: 2 (deck_build_trunk_list, deck_get_other_deck_free_copies).

column2: int deck_get_other_deck_free_copies(int slot, short card_id, void *recipe_deck)
column3: Returns deck_get_other_deck_card_allowance(slot, card_id, recipe_deck) (arguments passed through in their registers) minus the copies of card_id in slot's main and side lists (extra and side for fusion/synchro cards) (same code as rel_deck's). No side effects. Callers: 1 (deck_build_trunk_list).

Copies a UTF-16 string of at most max_units units, replacing line feeds (0x0a) by spaces; writes a terminating 0 only when the source ended within the limit (same code as rel_deck's). Returns nothing. Side effects: writes dst. Callers: 1 (ui_load_cursor_card_text).

Draws the tutorial's deck editor: clears layer 0 to black; unless bit 4 of 0x2259c is set, selects layer 4 with alpha blending and draws the background (ui_draw_editor_background), the card information of the shown card 0x22570 (0x19bb0), the panes (ui_draw_editor_panes) and the overlays (ui_draw_editor_overlays), then the fade on layer 5 (system_draw_fade). No return value. Side effects: GE display lists of layers 0, 4 and 5. Callers: 1 (deck_tutorial_draw).

Draws the editor's overlays by editor mode 0x221c0 (same code as rel_deck's): in mode 0 and modes 6/7 the pulsing cursor frame (shop_draw_cursor_frame over the cursor rectangle 0x224f2-0x224f8 with resource 0x8006, flags = frame counter); modes 6 and 7 also place the controller guide next to the cursor (y 0xa2 or 0x36 by the cursor's half of the screen; fixed positions in layouts 4-7) and draw it with shop_draw_button_help (buttons 0xf001, resource 0x8013 and dictionary 0x8033; variant 0 in mode 6 followed by 0x1a41c, the sort group header, variant 1 in mode 7). Modes 1-5 draw the card move, command menu, sort menu, filter menu or text search. Finally the message window (ui_draw_deck_message) when a message kind is set (bits 7-14 of 0x22560). Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (deck_tutorial_draw_editor).

Draws the editor's static layers in order, chaining the display list (passed through in a0, which Ghidra hides) (same code as rel_deck's): background layout, list-tab layout, row stripes for the layout mode (low nibble of 0x22560), header, pane status (icons, counts, scroll bars, tabs), frame-category counts and the frame-category bar. Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (deck_tutorial_draw_editor).

Plays the background .ehf layout, resource 0x8025 when bit 15 of 0x22560 is set and 0x8021 otherwise, through ui_ehf_begin_draw / ui_ehf_draw (0x60-byte parameter block whose first word is the frame counter) / ui_ehf_end_draw, then re-enables blending with the standard alpha blend and texture function (same code as rel_deck's). Returns the advanced display-list pointer (unchanged when the layout is missing). Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_editor_background).

Plays the list-tab .ehf layout (resource 0x8022, or 0x8023 when deck_tutorial_is_editing_other_deck) with the frame counter in a 0x60-byte parameter block; the frame range was set by deck_tutorial_play_list_tab_frames (same code as rel_deck's). Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_editor_background).

Draws the header texts (same code as rel_deck's): the deck name buffer 0x22180 (black, scale 0xc, fitted to 0x6f px at (0xa6, 5)), string 0x59 of dictionary resource 0x8033 (white, scale 0xb, at (0x1c1, 0xc), 0x1d px) and string 0x8e (white, scale 0xd, at (0x125, 5), 0x62 px), then the 4-digit number 0x221ce (in the tutorial the number of sample-deck entries, set by deck_tutorial_init_sample_deck) at x 0x1aa, y 5, pitch 8 (shop_draw_number_plain). Returns the list pointer of the final number draw (Ghidra shows void). Side effects: font commands. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_editor_background).

column2: void ui_list_tab_draw_text_fit_width_px(int x, int y, int width, void *text)
column3: Pixel wrapper (same code as BOOT.BIN ui_draw_level_badge_text_fit; the decompiler shows only the tail jump): system_font_draw_text_fit_width(x << 6, y << 6, width << 6, text, -1). Side effects: text drawn. Callers: 2 (ui_draw_editor_header, ui_draw_list_tab_label).

Draws the faint row separators of list-layout panes as untextured line pairs (vertex type 0x80011c, primitive 1) from 0x240 bytes of inline data (same code as rel_deck's): layout 0 seven rows at x 0x97, width 0x13d; layouts 4 and 6 six rows at x 3, width 0xe1; layouts 4 and 7 six rows at x 0xf3, width 0xe1; rows start at y 0x29 every 0x1e px (ui_fill_row_stripe_vertices). Returns the advanced display-list pointer (Ghidra shows void). Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_editor_background).

column2: void ui_fill_row_stripe_vertices(void *vertices, short x, short y, short width)
column3: Writes four 12-byte vertices (u32 colour, s16 x, y, z = 0) for two horizontal lines from x to x + width: at y in colour 0x33000000 and at y + 1 in 0x19000000 (same code as rel_deck's). Returns nothing. Side effects: writes 0x30 bytes at vertices. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_list_row_stripes).

Draws each pane's status decorations (pane 0, and pane 1 in two-pane layouts) at the pane's bottom-left (same code as rel_deck's): the sort-mode icon (ui_draw_table_icon_b, list +0x16 bits 0-3), the order icon (shop_draw_sort_order_icon, bits 4-5), and when filtered the filter icon (ui_draw_table_icon_a, bits 6-9) with the view count as up to 4 sprite digits (shop_draw_small_digits, resource 0x8009), blinking while message 6 is shown for that pane; for the trunk (list kind 3) with a trunk option set, the option icon (shop_draw_check_icon, resource 0x800a); then the pane's scroll bar at x + width - 10 (shop_draw_scrollbar) and finally the list tabs (deck_tutorial_draw_list_tabs). Returns the list from the tab drawing (Ghidra shows void). Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_editor_background).

Draws the list tabs: for each tab computes its rectangle (ui_calc_list_tab_rect, offset by the pane x 0x225ac / 0x225d8), draws the list's total (list object +0xc) with ui_draw_list_tab_count using the digit count from the u16 table 0x22064, then the label (ui_calc_list_tab_rect_narrow, ui_draw_list_tab_label). Single-pane layouts draw tabs 0-3 against pane 0's list (at index 4 the loop ends, so tabs 4 and 5 are not drawn); two-pane layouts draw tabs 0-2 against pane 0's list and 3-4 against pane 1's; list 2 (and in two-pane layouts list 4) is skipped while deck_tutorial_is_editing_other_deck. Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE and font commands. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_pane_status).

column2: void * ui_draw_list_tab_count(void *list, short x, short *rect, int digits, int value)
column3: When rect (x, y, w, h) is not empty, scissors to it and draws value as black font digits (scale 0xb x 0xc, pitch 8, digits positions) ending at x, at y + 1 (shop_draw_number_plain), then disables the scissor (same code as rel_deck's). Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE and font commands. Callers: 1 (deck_tutorial_draw_list_tabs).

column2: void * ui_draw_list_tab_label(void *list, short *rect, ushort list_id, ushort shown_list, short x_offset)
column3: When rect is not empty, draws the tab label of list_id (dictionary resource 0x8033 string from the u16 table 0x22070) scissored to rect shifted by x_offset, at scale 0xc, white for the shown list and grey 0xffbfbfbf otherwise, fitted to 0x22 px (same code as rel_deck's). Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE and font commands. Callers: 1 (deck_tutorial_draw_list_tabs).

Draws the seven deck counts per frame category (u16 at 0x221d0..0x221dd) as 2-digit sprite numbers (shop_draw_small_digits, resource 0x8009) (same code as rel_deck's): in layout modes 0-3 a column at x 0x7a, y 4 + 0x13 x i; in 4-7 a row at y 3, x 3 + 0x15 x i; single-digit values are shifted 3 px left. Returns the advanced display-list pointer (Ghidra shows void). Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_editor_background).

Draws the deck composition bar (same code as rel_deck's): with a non-zero total of the seven category counts (0x221d0) it splits a 0x82-px vertical bar at x 0x8d starting at y 1 (layout modes 0-3) or a 0x8d-px horizontal bar at y 0x12 starting at x 3 (modes 4-7) into segments proportional to the counts and draws each non-empty one with ui_draw_frame_category_segment. Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_editor_background).

column2: void * ui_draw_frame_category_segment(void *list, int x, int y, int length, int orientation, int category)
column3: Draws one bar segment by stretching a colour texel of resource 0x800a (same code as rel_deck's): orientation 1 or 3 is horizontal (length x 3 px), otherwise vertical (3 x length px); the texel is (0, 0x7a + category) for categories 0-3, (3, 0x7a) for category 4 and (0, 0x79 + category) above; orientation is also passed as the sprite flip flag. Returns the advanced display-list pointer (unchanged when the resource is missing). Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_frame_category_bar).

Draws the pane contents (same code as rel_deck's): pane 0 as a thumbnail grid (deck_tutorial_draw_card_grid) or detailed rows (ui_draw_list_rows_detailed) by its list-layout flag; in two-pane layouts pane 1 as a grid, compact rows (layout modes 2-3, ui_draw_list_rows_compact) or detailed rows (4-7). The pane record (0x225a0 / 0x225cc) is passed in a1, which the decompilation hides. Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE and font commands. Callers: 1 (deck_tutorial_draw_editor).

Draws the visible rows of a list-layout pane (same code as rel_deck's): from the first visible index (pane +6) up to the visible-row count (+0x18, clamped to the entries left), each row at x = pane x + cell x (+0x14), y = pane y + cell y (+0x16) + n x row height (+0x1c), width +0x1a, with deck_tutorial_draw_card_row_detailed(entry, list kind != 5, deck_is_main_or_side_list). Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE and font commands. Callers: 1 (ui_draw_editor_panes).

Draws a grid-layout pane: from the first visible index (pane +6), for up to the visible rows (+0x26) of columns (+0x22) at pitch +0x24 / +0x28 from the grid origin (+0xc + 0x1e, +0xe + 0x20), draws each entry's thumbnail (shop_draw_card_thumb with resources 0x8001/0x8002/0x8032, shadow) and its badges (shop_draw_card_badges: count shown, show_flag7 = list kind != 5, show_bit5 = deck_is_main_or_side_list, limit mode deck_tutorial_is_editing_other_deck, images 0x8009/0x800a/0x8006); stops at the end of the list's view. column2: void ui_field_reset_message_window(int x, int width, uchar font_size, int wait_input, int style)

No return value. Side effects: the message window block. Callers: 1 (ui_field_create_message_window).
Copies src[0] and src[1] to dest and returns dest (same code as the draw module's). Side effects: writes dest[0..1]. Callers: 1 (ui_field_reset_message_window).

Clears the continue-cursor GIM pointer 0x24c88, frees the message window list 0x24b34 (ui_window_list_free_all) and clears the 0x180-byte block 0x24b2c (same code as rel_field's). No return value. Side effects: window list, the block. Callers: 1 (deck_tutorial_shutdown).

Per-frame step of the message window (same code as rel_field's; state 0x24b2c: 0 hidden, 1 sliding in, 2 shown, 3 sliding out; slide by t 0x24b30 with the accelerating step k + k x t, k at 0x20640, system_vfpu_vector2_lerp). In state 2: advances the typewriter (once, or once per line when the text speed setting is 2), ticks the idle counter, and when the window waits for input and input is not locked (0x24c90): the confirm button, or holding confirm with R every third frame when save_test_progress_flag_e9_bit4 is set, speeds the current page up, turns to the next page when the page is full (sound 0x7a0b) or acknowledges the finished text (done flag 0x24c78 = 1, sound 0x7a0b); with no text the done flag is set at once. Updates the line positions while visible. Returns the done flag. Side effects: the message window block, sounds. Callers: 2 (deck_tutorial_run_script, deck_tutorial_op_message).

Draws the message window when visible (same code as rel_field's): its window list 0x24b34 (ui_draw_window_list, ruby off); then, with the message font state, for each line up to the current one a scissor rectangle that reveals the line's typed width (clipped at 0x110) and the whole page's text drawn as one text box at the window's inner rectangle shifted up by page x lines x (line height + 3) (ui_field_draw_message_line_text); finally, when waiting for input with the text fully printed and the window not animating, the blinking continue cursor from the GIM 0x24c88 (cell (idle counter / 10) & 1, source rectangle 0x20630-0x20636) at the window's bottom-right corner plus (0x20638, 0x2063c) (ui_field_draw_message_sprite). Side effects: *list_ptr, font state. Callers: 1 (deck_tutorial_draw).

column2: int ui_field_draw_message_line_text(int x, int y, int width, int height, void *text)

Stores gim in 0x24c88, the continue-cursor image of the message window. No return value. Side effects: 0x24c88. Callers: 1 (deck_tutorial_init_session, with resource 0x1010).
Returns 0x24b80, the 0x78-byte message window descriptor (deck_tutorial_init_session stores the frame GIM 0x1011 at its +4). No side effects. Callers: 1 (deck_tutorial_init_session).
Stores size in the bytes 0x24bcc and 0x24bd8 of the message window descriptor (same code as rel_field's). No return value. Side effects: those bytes. Callers: 1 (ui_field_reset_message_window).

Sets the text 0x24c10 of the message window and the title name (descriptor title text 0x24bd4, title enabled 0x24bac = name != NULL); resets the print state, lays out and splits the lines (ui_field_layout_message_lines, ui_field_split_message_lines) and opens the window when it is hidden (ui_field_open_message_window) (same code as rel_field's). No return value. Side effects: the message window block. Callers: 2 (deck_tutorial_op_message, ui_field_reset_message_window).
Sets the message window state 0x24b2c to 1 (slide in). No return value. Side effects: 0x24b2c. Callers: 1 (ui_field_set_message_text).

True while the message window is shown (state 2) with a text that is neither fully printed (0x24c74) nor waiting at a full page (0x24c7c) (same code as rel_field's). No side effects. Callers: 2 (ui_field_tick_message_idle_counter, ui_field_draw_message_window).
Returns 1 while the message window slides in (state 1) or out (state 3), else 0 (same code as rel_field's). No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_field_draw_message_window).

column2: void deck_tutorial_place_message_window(int x, int y, int width)
column3: Places the message window for a script message: current position 0x24c94/0x24c98 = (x, y) as floats, width 0x24c00 and descriptor width 0x24ba0 = width, and state 0x24b2c = 2 (shown at once, no slide). No return value. Side effects: those globals. Callers: 1 (deck_tutorial_op_message).

Creates the message window from the stored parameters (same code as rel_field's): initialises the window list 0x24b34 with the allocator 0x24bf8, fills the 0x78-byte descriptor 0x24b80 (enabled, skin style 0x24c1c, colour variant 2, x 0x24bfc, y 0xd2, size width 0x24c00 x 0x3c, white frame colours, shadow on, margins 4 / 0x14 / 2, black text, font scale 0x24c04, no title), adds it (ui_window_list_add) and resets the window (ui_field_reset_message_window). No return value. Side effects: window list, descriptor, block. Callers: 1 (ui_field_init_message_window).

Increments the idle counter 0x24c8c (drives the continue-cursor blink) while the message window is not printing (same code as rel_field's). Side effects: 0x24c8c. Callers: 1 (ui_field_update_message_window).

Advances the letter-by-letter reveal (same code as rel_field's): with no text marks it fully printed; otherwise widens the current line's revealed width (line record +0x08 at 0x24c20 + 0x18 x line) by the speed table 0x20624[text speed 0x24c14], capped at the line's pixel width (at most the inner width 0x24c0c); when the line is complete and the window is shown, advances the character cursor 0x24c80 by the line's character count and either marks the text fully printed, marks the page full (last line), or moves to the next line 0x24c68. Side effects: the message window block. Callers: 1 (ui_field_update_message_window).

Lays out the message lines for a new page (same code as rel_field's): resets the current line 0x24c68 and the page start 0x24c6c, takes the window's inner rectangle as the line width 0x24c0c and sets each of the 0x24c08 line records to {x = inner x, y = inner y + line x (line height + 3), revealed width 0, height = line height, start 0}. Side effects: line records. Callers: 2 (ui_field_update_message_window, ui_field_set_message_text).

Moves the message window descriptor to the current position (0x24c94/0x24c98 into x/y 0x24b8c/0x24b8e) and re-anchors each line record at the inner rectangle (x, inner y + line x (line height + 4)) (same code as rel_field's). Side effects: descriptor, line records. Callers: 2 (ui_field_update_message_window, ui_field_reset_message_window).

column2: void ui_field_draw_message_sprite(void **list_ptr, int x, int y, int z, int u, int v, int width, int height, int index)

Callers: 5 (ui_field_layout_message_lines, ui_field_advance_message_typewriter, ui_field_draw_message_window, ui_field_split_message_lines, ...).

Splits the current page of the message text into lines (same code as rel_field's): with the message font state and colour 0 (nothing visible) lays out each line from the running character position (starting at the page start 0x24c6c) through ui_field_draw_message_line_text with the line's box, records the start (+0x10) and character count (+0x14) of each line record, and skips one following space at a line break.
